parameters.name: ADSB_CALLSIGN_1
parameters.description:
Sets first 4 characters of a total of 8. Valid characters are A-Z, 0-9, " ". Example "PX4 " -> 1347957792
For CALLSIGN shorter than 8 characters use the null terminator at the end '\0'.

parameters.name: ADSB_CALLSIGN_2
parameters.description:
Sets second 4 characters of a total of 8. Valid characters are A-Z, 0-9, " " only. Example "TEST" -> 1413829460
For CALLSIGN shorter than 8 characters use the null terminator at the end '\0'.

parameters.name: ASPD_DO_CHECKS
parameters.description:
Controls which checks are run to check airspeed data for validity. Only applied if ASPD_PRIMARY > 0.

Note: The missing data check (bit 0) is implicitly always enabled when ASPD_DO_CHECKS > 0, even if bit 0 is not explicitly set.

bitmask.0: Only data missing check (triggers if more than 1s no data)
bitmask.1: Data stuck (triggers if data is exactly constant for 2s in FW mode)
bitmask.3: Load factor check (triggers if measurement is below stall speed)
bitmask.4: First principle check (airspeed change vs. throttle and pitch)

parameters.name: ASPD_FALLBACK
parameters.description: Fallback options

values.0: Fallback only to other airspeed sensors
values.2: Fallback to thrust based airspeed estimation

parameters.name: ASPD_FP_T_WINDOW
parameters.display_name: First principle airspeed check time window
parameters.description:
Window for comparing airspeed change to throttle and pitch change.
Triggers when the airspeed change within this window is negative while throttle increases
and the vehicle pitches down.
Is meant to catch degrading airspeed blockages as can happen when flying through icing conditions.
Relies on  FW_THR_TRIM being set accurately.

parameters.name: ASPD_FS_INNOV
parameters.description:
This specifies the minimum airspeed innovation required to trigger a failsafe. Larger values make the check less sensitive,
smaller values make it more sensitive. Large innovations indicate an inconsistency between predicted (groundspeed - windspeeed)
and measured airspeed.
The time required to detect a fault when the threshold is exceeded depends on the size of the exceedance and is controlled by the ASPD_FS_INTEG parameter.

parameters.name: ASPD_FS_INTEG
parameters.description:
This sets the time integral of airspeed innovation exceedance above ASPD_FS_INNOV required to trigger a failsafe.
Larger values make the check less sensitive, smaller positive values make it more sensitive.

parameters.name: ASPD_FS_T_START
parameters.description:
Delay before switching back to using airspeed sensor if checks indicate sensor is good.
Set to a negative value to disable the re-enabling in flight.

parameters.name: ASPD_FS_T_STOP
parameters.description: Delay before stopping use of airspeed sensor if checks indicate sensor is bad.

parameters.name: BAT1_CAPACITY
parameters.description: Defines the capacity of battery 1 in mAh.

parameters.name: BAT1_I_OVERWRITE
parameters.description:
This parameter allows to overwrite the current measured during
idle (unarmed) state with a user-defined constant value (expressed in amperes).
When the system is armed, the measured current is used. This is useful
because on certain ESCs current measurements are inaccurate in case of no load.
Negative values are ignored and will cause the measured current to be used.
The default value of 0 disables the overwrite, in which case the measured value
is always used.

parameters.name: BAT1_N_CELLS
parameters.description: Defines the number of cells the attached battery consists of.

parameters.name: BAT1_R_INTERNAL
parameters.display_name: Explicitly defines the per cell internal resistance for battery 1
parameters.description: If non-negative, then this will be used instead of the online estimated internal resistance.

parameters.name: BAT1_SOURCE
parameters.description:
This parameter controls the source of battery data. The value 'Power Module / Analog'
means that measurements are expected to come from either analog (ADC) inputs
or an I2C power monitor (e.g. INA226). Analog inputs are voltage and current
measurements read from the board's ADC channels, typically from an onboard
voltage divider and current shunt, or an external analog power module.
I2C power monitors are digital sensors on the I2C bus.
If the value is set to 'External' then the system expects to receive MAVLink
or CAN battery status messages, or the battery data is published by an external driver.
If the value is set to 'ESCs', the battery information are taken from the esc_status message.
This requires the ESC to provide both voltage as well as current (via ESC telemetry).

parameters.name: BAT1_V_CHARGED
parameters.description:
Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered full.
For a more accurate estimate set this below the nominal voltage of e.g. 4.2V

parameters.name: BAT1_V_EMPTY
parameters.description:
Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered empty.
The voltage should be chosen above the steep dropoff at 3.5V. A typical
lithium battery can only be discharged under high load down to 10% before
it drops off to a voltage level damaging the cells.

parameters.name: BAT_AVRG_CURRENT
parameters.description:
This value is used to initialize the in-flight average current estimation,
which in turn is used for estimating remaining flight time and RTL triggering.

parameters.name: BAT_CRIT_THR
parameters.description:
Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as critically low.
This has to be lower than the low threshold. This threshold commonly
will trigger RTL.

parameters.name: BAT_EMERGEN_THR
parameters.description:
Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as dangerously low.
This has to be lower than the critical threshold. This threshold commonly
will trigger landing.

parameters.name: BAT_LOW_THR
parameters.description:
Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as low.
This has to be higher than the critical threshold.

parameters.display_name: Report captures to the ground station
parameters.description:
Whether the autopilot reports captures to the ground station by emitting
CAMERA_IMAGE_CAPTURED.

Disable for cameras that report captures themselves (e.g. cameras
implementing the MAVLink Camera Protocol) to avoid duplicate
CAMERA_IMAGE_CAPTURED messages. Capture events are still published on the
camera_capture topic and logged for geotagging regardless of this setting.

parameters.name: CA_AIRFRAME
parameters.description:
Defines which mixer implementation to use.
Some are generic, while others are specifically fit to a certain vehicle with a fixed set of actuators.

'Custom' should only be used if noting else can be used.

parameters.name: CA_CS_LAUN_LK
parameters.description: If actuator launch lock is enabled, this surface is kept at the disarmed value.

parameters.name: CA_FAILURE_MODE
parameters.description:
What to do on a single motor failure. Ignore disables this feature entirely. Otherwise
the failed motor is removed from the allocation, and on a hexarotor its geometric-opposite
motor is additionally stopped (mode 1) or reversed (mode 2) to recover the lost
yaw/roll/pitch authority; on other airframes only the failed motor is removed. Mode 2
needs a reverse-capable ESC on the opposite motor.

values.1: Remove failed motor and stop its opposite
values.2: Remove failed motor and reverse its opposite

parameters.name: CA_HELI_PITCH_C0
parameters.description:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 0 for a given thrust setpoint.

Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_PITCH_C1
parameters.description:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 1 for a given thrust setpoint.

Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_PITCH_C2
parameters.description:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 2 for a given thrust setpoint.

Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_PITCH_C3
parameters.description:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 3 for a given thrust setpoint.

Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_PITCH_C4
parameters.description:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 4 for a given thrust setpoint.

Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_RPM_I
parameters.description: Same definition as the proportional gain but for integral.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_RPM_P
parameters.description:
Ratio between rpm error devided by 1000 to how much normalized output gets added to correct for it.

motor_command = throttle_curve + CA_HELI_RPM_P * (rpm_setpoint - rpm_measurement) / 1000

parameters.name: CA_HELI_RPM_SP
parameters.description: Requires rpm feedback for the controller.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_THR_C0
parameters.description: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 0.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_THR_C1
parameters.description: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 1.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_THR_C2
parameters.description: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 2.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_THR_C3
parameters.description: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 3.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_THR_C4
parameters.description: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 4.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_YAW_CCW
parameters.description:
Default configuration is for a clockwise turning main rotor and
positive thrust of the tail rotor is expected to rotate the vehicle clockwise.
Set this parameter to true if the tail rotor provides thrust in counter-clockwise direction
which is mostly the case when the main rotor turns counter-clockwise.

parameters.name: CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O
parameters.display_name: Offset for yaw compensation based on collective pitch
parameters.description:
This allows to specify which collective pitch command results in the least amount of rotor drag.
This is used to increase the accuracy of the yaw drag torque compensation based on collective pitch
by aligning the lowest rotor drag with zero compensation.
For symmetric profile blades this is the command that results in exactly 0° collective blade angle.
For lift profile blades this is typically a command resulting in slightly negative collective blade angle.

tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S * abs(collective_pitch - CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O)

parameters.name: CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S
parameters.display_name: Scale for yaw compensation based on collective pitch
parameters.description:
This allows to add a proportional factor of the collective pitch command to the yaw command.
A negative value is needed when positive thrust of the tail rotor rotates the vehicle opposite to the main rotor turn direction.

tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S * abs(collective_pitch - CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O)

parameters.name: CA_HELI_YAW_TH_S
parameters.display_name: Scale for yaw compensation based on throttle
parameters.description:
This allows to add a proportional factor of the throttle command to the yaw command.
A negative value is needed when positive thrust of the tail rotor rotates the vehicle opposite to the main rotor turn direction.

tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_TH_S * throttle

parameters.name: CA_ICE_PERIOD
parameters.description:
Ice shedding prevents ice buildup in VTOL aircraft motors by periodically spinning inactive rotors.
When enabled (period > 0), every cycle lasts for the defined period and includes a 2-second spin at 0.01 motor output.
If period <= 0, the feature is disabled.

parameters.name: CA_MAX_SVO_THROW
parameters.display_name: Throw angle of swashplate servo at maximum commands for linearization
parameters.description:
Used to linearize mechanical output of swashplate servos to avoid axis coupling and binding with 4 servo redundancy.
This requires a symmetric setup where the servo horn is exactly centered with a 0 command.
Setting to zero disables feature.

parameters.name: CA_METHOD
parameters.description:
Selects the algorithm and desaturation method.
If set to Automatic, the selection is based on the airframe (CA_AIRFRAME).

parameters.name: CA_R0_SLEW

to traverse its full range (normally [0, 1], or if reversible [-1, 1]).

parameters.name: CBRK_BUZZER
parameters.description:
Setting this parameter to 782097 will disable the buzzer audio notification.

Setting this parameter to 782090 will disable the startup tune, while keeping
all others enabled.

parameters.name: CBRK_FLIGHTTERM
parameters.description:
Setting this parameter to 121212 will disable the flight termination action if triggered
by the FailureDetector logic or if FMU is lost.
This circuit breaker does not affect the RC loss, data link loss, geofence,
and takeoff failure detection safety logic.

parameters.name: CBRK_IO_SAFETY
parameters.description:
Setting this parameter to 22027 will disable IO safety.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

parameters.name: CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK
parameters.display_name: Circuit breaker for power supply check
parameters.description:
Setting this parameter to 894281 will disable the power valid
checks in the commander.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

parameters.name: CBRK_UAVCAN_FW
parameters.display_name: Circuit breaker for UAVCAN firmware update arming check
parameters.description:
Setting this parameter to 5318008 will allow arming even when a UAVCAN
node firmware update is pending or a node went offline mid-update.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

parameters.name: CBRK_USB_CHK
parameters.display_name: Circuit breaker for USB link check
parameters.description:
Setting this parameter to 197848 will disable the USB connected
checks in the commander, setting it to 0 keeps them enabled (recommended).

We are generally recommending to not fly with the USB link
connected and production vehicles should set this parameter to
zero to prevent users from flying USB powered. However, for R&D purposes
it has proven over the years to work just fine.

parameters.name: CBRK_VTOLARMING
parameters.display_name: Circuit breaker for arming in fixed-wing mode check
parameters.description:
Setting this parameter to 159753 will enable arming in fixed-wing
mode for VTOLs.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

parameters.name: COM_ACT_FAIL_ACT
parameters.display_name: Set the actuator failure failsafe mode
parameters.description:
Note: actuator failure needs to be enabled and configured via FD_ACT_*
parameters.

parameters.name: COM_ARMABLE
parameters.description: Set 0 to prevent accidental use of the vehicle e.g. for safety or maintenance reasons.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_AUTH_ID
parameters.description: Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_AUTH_MET
parameters.description:
Methods:
- one arm: request authorization and arm when authorization is received
- two step arm: 1st arm command request an authorization and
2nd arm command arm the drone if authorized

Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ
parameters.description: By default off. The default allows to arm the vehicle without a arm authorization.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_AUTH_TO
parameters.description:
Timeout for authorizer answer.
Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_BAT_MIN
parameters.description:
Threshold for battery percentage below arming is prohibited.

A negative value means BAT_CRIT_THR is the threshold.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_CHK_ESCS
parameters.display_name: Enable checks on ESCs that report telemetry
parameters.description:
If this parameter is set, the system will check ESC's online status and failures.
This param is specific for ESCs reporting status. It shall be used only if ESCs support telemetry.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_HFLT_CHK
parameters.display_name: Enable FMU SD card hardfault / watchdog detection check
parameters.description:
This check detects if there are hardfault / watchdog files present on the
SD card. If so, and the parameter is enabled, arming is prevented.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_IMU_ACC
parameters.description: Maximum accelerometer inconsistency between IMU units that will allow arming

parameters.name: COM_ARM_IMU_GYR
parameters.display_name: Max rate gyro inconsistency for arming
parameters.description: Maximum rate gyro inconsistency between IMU units that will allow arming

parameters.name: COM_ARM_MAG_ANG
parameters.display_name: Max magnetic field inconsistency for arming
parameters.description:
Maximum magnetic field inconsistency between units that will allow arming

Set -1 to disable the check.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_MAG_STR
parameters.description:
Check if the estimator detects a strong magnetic
disturbance (check enabled by EKF2_MAG_CHECK)

parameters.name: COM_ARM_MIS_REQ
parameters.description: The default allows to arm the vehicle without a valid mission.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_ODID
parameters.display_name: Open Drone ID system check and in-flight failsafe
parameters.description: Actions other than warning also prevent arming.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_ON_BOOT
parameters.description:
When enabled, the vehicle arms automatically once all preflight checks pass after boot.
The vehicle will not re-arm after a manual disarm.
Has no effect if COM_ARMABLE is 0.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_SWISBTN
parameters.display_name: Arm switch is a momentary button
parameters.description:
0: Arming/disarming triggers on switch transition.
1: Arming/disarming triggers when holding the momentary button down like the stick gesture.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_WO_GPS
parameters.description:
Configures whether arming is allowed without GNSS, for modes that require a global position
(specifically, in those modes when a check defined by EKF2_GPS_CHECK fails).
The settings deny arming and warn, allow arming and warn, or silently allow arming.

parameters.name: COM_CC_TEMP_WARN
parameters.description:
Arming is not prevented as the temperature typically drops in flight.

Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: COM_CPU_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum allowed CPU load to still arm
parameters.description:
The check fails if the CPU load is above this threshold for 2s.

A negative value disables the check.

parameters.name: COM_DISARM_LAND
parameters.display_name: Time-out for auto disarm after landing
parameters.description:
A non-zero, positive value specifies the time-out period in seconds after which the vehicle will be
automatically disarmed in case a landing situation has been detected during this period.

A zero or negative value means that automatic disarming triggered by landing detection is disabled.

parameters.name: COM_DISARM_PRFLT
parameters.display_name: Time-out for auto disarm if not taking off
parameters.description:
A non-zero, positive value specifies the time in seconds, within which the
vehicle is expected to take off after arming. In case the vehicle didn't takeoff
within the timeout it disarms again.

A negative value disables autmoatic disarming triggered by a pre-takeoff timeout.

parameters.name: COM_DLL_EXCEPT
parameters.description:
Specify modes in which ground control station connection loss is ignored and no failsafe action is triggered.
See also COM_RCL_EXCEPT.

parameters.name: COM_DL_LOSS_T
parameters.description: After this amount of seconds without datalink, the GCS connection lost mode triggers

parameters.name: COM_FAIL_ACT_T
parameters.display_name: Delay between failsafe condition triggered and failsafe reaction
parameters.description:
Before entering failsafe (RTL, Land, Hold), wait COM_FAIL_ACT_T seconds in Hold mode
for the user to realize.
During that time the user can switch modes, but cannot take over control via the manual control override feature (see MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD).
Afterwards the configured failsafe action is triggered and the user may use manual control override.

A zero value disables the delay.

parameters.name: COM_FLIGHT_UUID
parameters.description:
This number is incremented automatically after every flight on
disarming in order to remember the next flight UUID.
The first flight is 0.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE1
parameters.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE2
parameters.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE3
parameters.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE4
parameters.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE5
parameters.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE6
parameters.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE_BOOT
parameters.description:
Flight mode set on boot and after a power cycle, before any RC input or
mode command is received.

parameters.name: COM_FLTT_LOW_ACT
parameters.description:
Action the system takes when the remaining flight time is below
the estimated time it takes to reach the RTL destination.

parameters.name: COM_FLT_TIME_MAX
parameters.description:
The vehicle aborts the current operation and returns to launch when
the time since takeoff is above this value. It is not possible to resume the
mission or switch to any auto mode other than RTL or Land. Taking over in any manual
mode is still possible.

Starting from 90% of the maximum flight time, a warning message will be sent
every 1 minute with the remaining time until automatic RTL.

Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: COM_FORCE_SAFETY
parameters.description: Force safety when the vehicle disarms

parameters.name: COM_GNSSLOSS_ACT
parameters.description:
Action the system takes when a GNSS failure is detected during flight.
Triggers when the active GNSS count drops below SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS (disabled
when SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS=0), or when two receivers report positions inconsistent
with their reported accuracy and SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS=2 (otherwise warning only).
Any value above Warning also blocks arming.

parameters.name: COM_HLDL_LOSS_T
parameters.display_name: High Latency Datalink loss time threshold
parameters.description: After this amount of seconds without datalink the data link lost mode triggers

parameters.name: COM_HOME_EN
parameters.description:
Set home position automatically if possible.

During missions, the latitude/longitude of the home position is locked and will not reset during intermediate landings.
It will only update once the mission is complete or landed outside of a mission.
However, the altitude is still being adjusted to correct for GNSS vertical drift in the first 2 minutes after takeoff.

parameters.name: COM_HOME_IN_AIR
parameters.display_name: Allows setting the home position after takeoff
parameters.description:
If set to true, the autopilot is allowed to set its home position after takeoff
The true home position is back-computed if a local position is estimate if available.
If no local position is available, home is set to the current position.

parameters.name: COM_LOW_BAT_ACT
parameters.description:
Action the system takes at critical battery. See also BAT_CRIT_THR and BAT_EMERGEN_THR
for definition of battery states.

values.3: Return at critical level, land at emergency level
values.4: Return at critical level, terminate at emergency level

parameters.name: COM_MODE0_HASH
parameters.description:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

parameters.name: COM_MODE1_HASH
parameters.description:

get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

parameters.name: COM_MODE_ARM_CHK
parameters.display_name: Allow external mode registration while armed
parameters.description: By default disabled for safety reasons

parameters.name: COM_OBL_RC_ACT
parameters.description:
The offboard loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_OF_LOSS_T in seconds.

parameters.name: COM_OF_LOSS_T
parameters.description:
Time-out to wait when offboard connection is lost before triggering offboard lost action

See COM_OBL_RC_ACT to configure action.

parameters.name: COM_PARACHUTE
parameters.description:
Require a MAVLink parachute system for arming and the failsafe action when missing or unhealthy.

Warning only warns without preventing arming. Actions other than Warning also prevent arming.

parameters.name: COM_POS_FS_ACT
parameters.description:
Final fallback failsafe action for loss of horizontal position in autonomous modes:
- Descend (potential for horizontal drift on landing)
- Flight termination (allows parachute landing)

parameters.name: COM_POS_FS_EPH
parameters.display_name: Horizontal position error threshold for hovering systems
parameters.description:
This is the horizontal position error (EPH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe.
If the previous position error was below this threshold, there is an additional
factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).
Only used for multicopters and VTOLs in hover mode.
Independent from estimator positioning data timeout threshold (see EKF2_NOAID_TOUT).

Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: COM_POS_LOW_ACT
parameters.description:
Action the system takes when the estimated position has an accuracy below the specified threshold.
See COM_POS_LOW_EPH to set the failsafe threshold.
The failsafe action is only executed if the vehicle is in auto mission or auto loiter mode,
otherwise it is only a warning.

parameters.name: COM_POS_LOW_EPH
parameters.description:
This triggers the action specified in COM_POS_LOW_ACT if the estimated position accuracy is below this threshold.
Local position has to be still declared valid, which requires some kind of velocity aiding or large dead-reckoning time (EKF2_NOAID_TOUT),
and a high failsafe threshold (COM_POS_FS_EPH).

Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: COM_POWER_COUNT
parameters.display_name: Required number of redundant power modules
parameters.description:
This configures a check to verify the expected number of 5V rail power supplies are present. By default only one is expected.
Note: CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK disables all power checks including this one.

parameters.name: COM_PREARM_MODE
parameters.description:
Condition to enter the prearmed state, an intermediate state between disarmed and armed
in which non-throttling actuators are active.

parameters.name: COM_QC_ACT
parameters.description: Set action after a quadchute

parameters.name: COM_RAM_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum allowed RAM usage to pass checks
parameters.description:
The check fails if the RAM usage is above this threshold.

A negative value disables the check.

parameters.name: COM_RCL_EXCEPT
parameters.description:
Specify modes in which stick input is ignored and no failsafe action is triggered.
External modes requiring stick input will still failsafe.
Auto modes are: Hold, Takeoff, Land, RTL, Descend, Follow Target, Precland, Orbit.

parameters.name: COM_RC_IN_MODE
parameters.description:
Selects stick input selection behavior:
either a traditional remote control receiver (RC) or a MAVLink joystick (MANUAL_CONTROL message)

Priority sources are immediately switched to whenever they get valid.

0 RC only. Requires valid RC calibration.
1 MAVLink only. RC and related checks are disabled.
2 Switches only if current source becomes invalid.
3 Locks to the first valid source until reboot.
4 Ignores all sources.
5 RC priority, then MAVLink (lower instance before higher)
6 MAVLink priority (lower instance before higher), then RC
7 RC priority, then MAVLink (higher instance before lower)
8 MAVLink priority (higher instance before lower), then RC

parameters.name: COM_RC_LOSS_T
parameters.description:
The time in seconds without a new setpoint from RC or Joystick, after which the connection is considered lost.
This must be kept short as the vehicle will use the last supplied setpoint until the timeout triggers.
Ensure the value is not set lower than the update interval of the RC or Joystick.

parameters.name: COM_SPOOLUP_TIME
parameters.display_name: Enforced delay between arming and further navigation
parameters.description:
The minimal time from arming the motors until moving the vehicle is possible is COM_SPOOLUP_TIME seconds.
Goal:
- Motors and propellers spool up to idle speed before getting commanded to spin faster
- Timeout for ESCs and smart batteries to successfulyy do failure checks
e.g. for stuck rotors before the vehicle is off the ground

parameters.name: COM_THROW_EN
parameters.description: Allows to start the vehicle by throwing it into the air.

parameters.name: COM_THROW_SPEED
parameters.display_name: Minimum speed for the throw start
parameters.description:
When the throw launch is enabled, the drone will only allow motors to spin after this speed
is exceeded before detecting the freefall. This is a safety feature to ensure the drone does
not turn on after accidental drop or a rapid movement before the throw.

Set to 0 to disable.

parameters.name: COM_TRAFF_AVOID
parameters.display_name: Traffic avoidance system requirement and failsafe
parameters.description:
Warn about, and optionally require, a traffic avoidance system (ADS-B/FLARM
transponder, detected via MAVLink heartbeats with a 3 second timeout), and
trigger a failsafe action when it is missing or lost in flight.

parameters.name: COM_VEL_FS_EVH
parameters.description:
This is the horizontal velocity error (EVH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe.
The default is appropriate for a multicopter. Can be increased for a fixed-wing.
If the previous velocity error was below this threshold, there is an additional
factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).

parameters.name: COM_WIND_MAX
parameters.description:
Wind speed threshold above which an automatic failsafe action is triggered.
Failsafe action can be specified with COM_WIND_MAX_ACT.

parameters.name: COM_WIND_MAX_ACT
parameters.description:
Action the system takes when a wind speed above the specified threshold is detected.
See COM_WIND_MAX to set the failsafe threshold.
If enabled, it is not possible to resume the mission or switch to any auto mode other than
RTL or Land if this threshold is exceeded. Taking over in any manual
mode is still possible.

parameters.name: COM_WIND_WARN
parameters.description:
A warning is triggered if the currently estimated wind speed is above this value.
Warning is sent periodically (every 1 minute).

Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: CP_DELAY
parameters.display_name: Range sensor and position controller average delay
parameters.description:
Average delay of the range sensor message plus the tracking delay of the position controller in seconds

Only used in Position mode.

parameters.name: CP_DIST
parameters.display_name: Minimum distance the vehicle should keep to all obstacles
parameters.description: Only used in Position mode. Collision avoidance is disabled by setting this parameter to a negative value

parameters.name: CP_GO_NO_DATA
parameters.display_name: Allow moving into directions without sensor data
parameters.description:
Boolean to allow moving into directions where there is no sensor data (outside FOV)

Only used in Position mode.

parameters.name: CP_GUIDE_ANG
parameters.description:
Angle left/right from the commanded setpoint by which the collision prevention algorithm can choose to change the setpoint direction

Only used in Position mode.

parameters.name: DAA_DFLT_VEL
parameters.display_name: Default vertical speed of other aircraft
parameters.description: Used when DAA_EN_DFLT_VEL is enabled. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_EN
parameters.description: Enable DAA

parameters.name: DAA_EN_DFLT_VEL
parameters.display_name: Ignore reported vertical speed of other aircraft
parameters.description: Use DAA_DFLT_VEL instead of reported traffic vertical speed. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_LVL_CRIT_ACT
parameters.description:
Action requested when the critical conflict level is reached.
Runtime changes apply on later conflict level transitions.
Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_LVL_CRIT_HGT
parameters.description: Per-aircraft half-zone. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_LVL_CRIT_RAD
parameters.description: Per-aircraft half-zone. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_LVL_HIGH_ACT
parameters.description:
Action requested when the high conflict level is reached.
Runtime changes apply on later conflict level transitions.
Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_LVL_HIGH_HGT
parameters.description: Per-aircraft half-zone. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_LVL_HIGH_RAD
parameters.description: Per-aircraft half-zone. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_LVL_LOW_ACT
parameters.description:
Action requested when the low conflict level is reached.
Runtime changes apply on later conflict level transitions.
Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_LVL_LOW_TIME
parameters.description: Expands well-clear bounds by aircraft speed times this value. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_LVL_MED_ACT
parameters.description:
Action requested when the medium conflict level is reached.
Runtime changes apply on later conflict level transitions.
Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_LVL_MED_TIME
parameters.description: Expands NMAC bounds by aircraft speed times this value. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

parameters.name: DAA_NOTIF_STATE
parameters.description: Time between notifications for the most urgent conflict. Set to 0 to disable the periodic status notification.

parameters.name: DAA_TRAFF_TOUT
parameters.description: Conflict age before removal.

parameters.name: EKF2_ABIAS_INIT
parameters.description: 1-sigma IMU accelerometer switch-on bias

parameters.name: EKF2_ABL_ACCLIM
parameters.display_name: Maximum IMU accel magnitude that allows IMU bias learning
parameters.description: If the magnitude of the IMU accelerometer vector exceeds this value, the EKF accel bias state estimation will be inhibited. This reduces the adverse effect of high manoeuvre accelerations and IMU nonlinerity and scale factor errors on the accel bias estimates.

parameters.name: EKF2_ABL_GYRLIM
parameters.display_name: Maximum IMU gyro angular rate magnitude that allows IMU bias learning
parameters.description: If the magnitude of the IMU angular rate vector exceeds this value, the EKF accel bias state estimation will be inhibited. This reduces the adverse effect of rapid rotation rates and associated errors on the accel bias estimates.

parameters.name: EKF2_ABL_LIM
parameters.description: The ekf accel bias states will be limited to within a range equivalent to +- of this value.

parameters.name: EKF2_ABL_TAU
parameters.display_name: Accel bias learning inhibit time constant
parameters.description: The vector magnitude of angular rate and acceleration used to check if learning should be inhibited has a peak hold filter applied to it with an exponential decay. This parameter controls the time constant of the decay.

parameters.name: EKF2_ACC_B_NOISE
parameters.display_name: Process noise for IMU accelerometer bias prediction
parameters.description: Process noise for IMU accelerometer bias prediction

parameters.name: EKF2_ACC_NOISE

parameters.display_name: 1-sigma tilt angle uncertainty after gravity vector alignment
parameters.description: 1-sigma tilt angle uncertainty after gravity vector alignment

parameters.name: EKF2_ARSP_THR
parameters.description: Airspeed data is fused for wind estimation if above this threshold. Set to 0 to disable airspeed fusion. For reliable wind estimation both sideslip (see EKF2_FUSE_BETA) and airspeed fusion should be enabled. Only applies to fixed-wing vehicles (or VTOLs in fixed-wing mode).

parameters.name: EKF2_ASPD_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum airspeed used for baro static pressure compensation
parameters.description: Maximum airspeed used for baro static pressure compensation

parameters.name: EKF2_ASP_DELAY
parameters.display_name: Airspeed measurement delay relative to IMU measurements
parameters.description: Airspeed measurement delay relative to IMU measurements

parameters.name: EKF2_AVEL_DELAY
parameters.display_name: Auxiliary Velocity Estimate delay relative to IMU measurements
parameters.description: Auxiliary Velocity Estimate delay relative to IMU measurements

parameters.name: EKF2_AVEL_EN
parameters.display_name: Fuse the landing-target relative velocity as auxiliary velocity
parameters.description:
When enabled, EKF2 fuses the relative velocity published in landing_target_pose
(vx_rel, vy_rel) as a horizontal auxiliary velocity measurement. The data is
only fused when landing_target_pose.rel_vel_ekf2_valid is true.

parameters.name: EKF2_BARO_CTRL
parameters.description: If this parameter is enabled then the estimator will make use of the barometric height measurements to estimate its height in addition to other height sources (if activated).

parameters.name: EKF2_BARO_DELAY
parameters.display_name: Barometer measurement delay relative to IMU measurements
parameters.description: Barometer measurement delay relative to IMU measurements

parameters.name: EKF2_BARO_GATE
parameters.display_name: Gate size for barometric and GPS height fusion
parameters.description: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

parameters.name: EKF2_BARO_NOISE
parameters.description: Measurement noise for barometric altitude

parameters.name: EKF2_BCOEF_X
parameters.display_name: X-axis ballistic coefficient used for multi-rotor wind estimation
parameters.description: This parameter controls the prediction of drag produced by bluff body drag along the forward/reverse axis when flying a multi-copter which enables estimation of wind drift when enabled by the EKF2_DRAG_CTRL parameter. The drag produced by this effect scales with speed squared. The predicted drag from the rotors is specified separately by the EKF2_MCOEF parameter. Set this parameter to zero to turn off the bluff body drag model for this axis.

parameters.name: EKF2_BCOEF_Y
parameters.display_name: Y-axis ballistic coefficient used for multi-rotor wind estimation
parameters.description: This parameter controls the prediction of drag produced by bluff body drag along the right/left axis when flying a multi-copter, which enables estimation of wind drift when enabled by the EKF2_DRAG_CTRL parameter. The drag produced by this effect scales with speed squared. The predicted drag from the rotors is specified separately by the EKF2_MCOEF parameter. Set this parameter to zero to turn off the bluff body drag model for this axis.

parameters.name: EKF2_BETA_GATE
parameters.display_name: Gate size for synthetic sideslip fusion
parameters.description: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

parameters.name: EKF2_BETA_NOISE
parameters.description: Noise for synthetic sideslip fusion

parameters.name: EKF2_DECL_TYPE
parameters.display_name: Integer bitmask controlling handling of magnetic declination
parameters.description: Set bits in the following positions to enable functions. 0 : Set to true to use the declination from the geo_lookup library when the GPS position becomes available, set to false to always use the EKF2_MAG_DECL value. 1 : Set to true to save the EKF2_MAG_DECL parameter to the value returned by the EKF when the vehicle disarms.

parameters.name: EKF2_DELAY_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum delay of all the aiding sensors
parameters.description: Defines the delay between the current time and the delayed-time horizon. This value should be at least as large as the largest EKF2_XXX_DELAY parameter.

parameters.name: EKF2_DRAG_CTRL
parameters.description: Activate wind speed estimation using specific-force measurements and a drag model defined by EKF2_BCOEF_[XY] and EKF2_MCOEF. Only use on vehicles that have their thrust aligned with the Z axis and no thrust in the XY plane.

parameters.name: EKF2_DRAG_NOISE
parameters.display_name: Specific drag force observation noise variance
parameters.description: Used by the multi-rotor specific drag force model. Increasing this makes the multi-rotor wind estimates adjust more slowly.

parameters.name: EKF2_EAS_NOISE
parameters.description: Measurement noise for airspeed fusion

parameters.name: EKF2_EN
parameters.description: EKF2 enable

parameters.name: EKF2_EVA_NOISE
parameters.display_name: Measurement noise for vision angle measurements
parameters.description: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

parameters.name: EKF2_EVP_GATE

parameters.description: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

parameters.name: EKF2_EVP_NOISE
parameters.display_name: Measurement noise for vision position measurements
parameters.description: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

parameters.name: EKF2_EVV_GATE

parameters.description: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

parameters.name: EKF2_EVV_NOISE
parameters.display_name: Measurement noise for vision velocity measurements
parameters.description: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

parameters.name: EKF2_EV_CTRL

parameters.name: EKF2_EV_DELAY
parameters.display_name: Vision Position Estimator delay relative to IMU measurements
parameters.description: Vision Position Estimator delay relative to IMU measurements

parameters.description: If set to 0 (default) the measurement noise is taken from the vision message and the EV noise parameters are used as a lower bound. If set to 1 the observation noise is set from the parameters directly,

parameters.name: EKF2_EV_POS_X
parameters.display_name: X position of VI sensor focal point in body frame
parameters.description: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

parameters.name: EKF2_EV_POS_Y
parameters.display_name: Y position of VI sensor focal point in body frame
parameters.description: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

parameters.name: EKF2_EV_POS_Z

parameters.description: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

parameters.name: EKF2_MAG_CHECK
parameters.description: Bitmask to set which check is used to decide whether the magnetometer data is valid. If GNSS data is received, the magnetic field is compared to a World Magnetic Model (WMM), otherwise an average value is used. This check is useful to reject occasional hard iron disturbance. Set bits to 1 to enable checks. Checks enabled by the following bit positions 0 : Magnetic field strength. Set tolerance using EKF2_MAG_CHK_STR 1 : Magnetic field inclination. Set tolerance using EKF2_MAG_CHK_INC 2 : Wait for GNSS to find the theoretical strength and inclination using the WMM

parameters.description: Maximum allowed deviation from the expected magnetic field inclination to pass the check.

parameters.name: EKF2_MAG_CHK_STR

parameters.description: Measurement noise for magnetometer 3-axis fusion

parameters.name: EKF2_MAG_TYPE
parameters.description: Integer controlling the type of magnetometer fusion used - magnetic heading or 3-component vector. The fusion of magnetometer data as a three component vector enables vehicle body fixed hard iron errors to be learned, but requires a stable earth field. If set to 'Automatic' magnetic heading fusion is used when on-ground and 3-axis magnetic field fusion in-flight. If set to 'Magnetic heading' magnetic heading fusion is used at all times. If set to 'None' the magnetometer will not be used under any circumstance. If no external source of yaw is available, it is possible to use post-takeoff horizontal movement combined with GNSS velocity measurements to align the yaw angle. If set to 'Init' the magnetometer is only used to initialize the heading.

parameters.name: EKF2_MCOEF
parameters.display_name: Propeller momentum drag coefficient for multi-rotor wind estimation
parameters.description: This parameter controls the prediction of drag produced by the propellers when flying a multi-copter, which enables estimation of wind drift when enabled by the EKF2_DRAG_CTRL parameter. The drag produced by this effect scales with speed not speed squared and is produced because some of the air velocity normal to the propeller axis of rotation is lost when passing through the rotor disc. This  changes the momentum of the flow which creates a drag reaction force. When comparing un-ducted propellers of the same diameter, the effect is roughly proportional to the area of the propeller blades when viewed side on and changes with propeller selection. Momentum drag is significantly higher for ducted rotors. To account for the drag produced by the body which scales with speed squared, see documentation for the EKF2_BCOEF_X and EKF2_BCOEF_Y parameters. Set this parameter to zero to turn off the momentum drag model for both axis.

parameters.name: EKF2_MIN_RNG
parameters.display_name: Expected range finder reading when on ground
parameters.description: If the vehicle is on ground, is not moving as determined by the motion test and the range finder is returning invalid or no data, then an assumed range value of EKF2_MIN_RNG will be used by the terrain estimator so that a terrain height estimate is available at the start of flight in situations where the range finder may be inside its minimum measurements distance when on ground.

parameters.name: EKF2_MULTI_IMU
parameters.description: Maximum number of IMUs to use for Multi-EKF. Set 0 to disable. Requires SENS_IMU_MODE 0.

parameters.name: EKF2_MULTI_MAG
parameters.description: Maximum number of magnetometers to use for Multi-EKF. Set 0 to disable. Requires SENS_MAG_MODE 0.

parameters.name: EKF2_NOAID_NOISE

parameters.name: EKF2_OF_DELAY
parameters.display_name: Optical flow measurement delay relative to IMU measurements
parameters.description: Assumes measurement is timestamped at trailing edge of integration period

parameters.name: EKF2_OF_GATE
parameters.display_name: Gate size for optical flow fusion
parameters.description: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

parameters.name: EKF2_OF_GYR_SRC
parameters.display_name: Optical flow angular rate compensation source
parameters.description: Auto: use gyro from optical flow message if available, internal gyro otherwise. Internal: always use internal gyro

parameters.name: EKF2_OF_N_MAX
parameters.description: Measurement noise for the optical flow sensor when it's reported quality metric is at the minimum

parameters.name: EKF2_OF_N_MIN
parameters.description: Measurement noise for the optical flow sensor when it's reported quality metric is at the maximum

parameters.description: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

parameters.display_name: In air optical flow minimum quality
parameters.description: Optical Flow data will only be used in air if the sensor reports a quality metric >= EKF2_OF_QMIN

parameters.name: EKF2_OF_QMIN_GND
parameters.display_name: On ground optical flow minimum quality
parameters.description: Optical Flow data will only be used on the ground if the sensor reports a quality metric >= EKF2_OF_QMIN_GND

parameters.name: EKF2_PCOEF_XN
parameters.display_name: Static pressure position error coefficient for the negative X axis
parameters.description: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a negative wind relative velocity along the X body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during backwards flight, then this will be a negative number.

parameters.name: EKF2_PCOEF_XP
parameters.display_name: Static pressure position error coefficient for the positive X axis
parameters.description: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a positive wind relative velocity along the X body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during forward flight, then this will be a negative number.

parameters.name: EKF2_PCOEF_YN
parameters.display_name: Pressure position error coefficient for the negative Y axis
parameters.description: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a wind relative velocity along the negative Y (LH) body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during sideways flight to the left, then this will be a negative number.

parameters.name: EKF2_PCOEF_YP
parameters.display_name: Pressure position error coefficient for the positive Y axis
parameters.description: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a wind relative velocity along the positive Y (RH) body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during sideways flight to the right, then this will be a negative number.

parameters.name: EKF2_PCOEF_Z
parameters.display_name: Static pressure position error coefficient for the Z axis
parameters.description: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a wind relative velocity along the Z body axis.

parameters.name: EKF2_POS_LOCK
parameters.display_name: Enable constant position fusion while on ground
parameters.description: When enabled, constant position fusion is enabled when the vehicle is landeded if position has been initialized but has currently no vel/pos aiding.

parameters.name: EKF2_PREDICT_US
parameters.description: EKF prediction period in microseconds. This should ideally be an integer multiple of the IMU time delta. Actual filter update will be an integer multiple of IMU update.

parameters.name: EKF2_RNG_A_HMAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum height above ground allowed for conditional range aid mode
parameters.description: If the vehicle absolute altitude exceeds this value then the estimator will not fuse range measurements to estimate its height. This only applies when conditional range aid mode is activated (EKF2_RNG_CTRL = 1).

parameters.name: EKF2_RNG_A_VMAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum horizontal velocity allowed for conditional range aid mode
parameters.description: If the vehicle horizontal speed exceeds this value then the estimator will not fuse range measurements to estimate its height. This only applies when conditional range aid mode is activated (EKF2_RNG_CTRL = 1).

parameters.name: EKF2_RNG_CTRL
parameters.description: WARNING: Range finder measurements are less reliable and can experience unexpected errors. For these reasons, if accurate control of height relative to ground is required, it is recommended to use the MPC_ALT_MODE parameter instead, unless baro errors are severe enough to cause problems with landing and takeoff. If this parameter is enabled then the estimator will make use of the range finder measurements to estimate its height in addition to other height sources (if activated). Range sensor aiding can be enabled (i.e.: always use) or set in "conditional" mode. Conditional mode: This enables the range finder to be used during low speed (< EKF2_RNG_A_VMAX) and low altitude (< EKF2_RNG_A_HMAX) operation, eg takeoff and landing, where baro interference from rotor wash is excessive and can corrupt EKF state estimates. It is intended to be used where a vertical takeoff and landing is performed, and horizontal flight does not occur until above EKF2_RNG_A_HMAX.

parameters.name: EKF2_RNG_DELAY
parameters.display_name: Range finder measurement delay relative to IMU measurements
parameters.description: Range finder measurement delay relative to IMU measurements

parameters.name: EKF2_RNG_FOG
parameters.display_name: Maximum distance at which the range finder could detect fog (m)
parameters.description: Limit for fog detection. If the range finder measures a distance greater than this value, the measurement is considered to not be blocked by fog or rain. If there's a jump from larger than RNG_FOG to smaller than EKF2_RNG_FOG, the measurement may gets rejected. 0 - disabled

parameters.name: EKF2_RNG_K_GATE
parameters.display_name: Gate size used for range finder kinematic consistency check
parameters.description: To be used, the time derivative of the distance sensor measurements projected on the vertical axis needs to be statistically consistent with the estimated vertical velocity of the drone. Decrease this value to make the filter more robust against range finder faulty data (stuck, reflections, ...). Note: tune the range finder noise parameters (EKF2_RNG_NOISE and EKF2_RNG_SFE) before tuning this gate.

parameters.name: EKF2_SEL_ERR_RED
parameters.description: EKF2 instances have to be better than the selected by at least this amount before their relative score can be reduced.

parameters.name: EKF2_SEL_IMU_ACC
parameters.description: EKF2 selector acceleration error threshold for comparing accelerometers. Acceleration vector differences larger than this will result in accumulated velocity error.

parameters.name: EKF2_SEL_IMU_ANG
parameters.description: EKF2 selector maximum accumulated angular error threshold for comparing gyros. Accumulated angular error larger than this will result in the sensor being declared faulty.

parameters.name: EKF2_SEL_IMU_RAT
parameters.description: EKF2 selector angular rate error threshold for comparing gyros. Angular rate vector differences larger than this will result in accumulated angular error.

parameters.name: EKF2_SEL_IMU_VEL
