parameters.name: EKF2_SENS_EN
parameters.description: Bitmask to control which sensor fusion sources are enabled. Sources whose bit is cleared will be disabled. Only applied while disarmed. For in-flight changes use the MAVLink command VEHICLE_CMD_ESTIMATOR_SENSOR_ENABLE or the individual CTRL params (e.g. EKF2_GPS_CTRL, EKF2_BARO_CTRL).

parameters.name: EKF2_SYNT_MAG_Z
parameters.display_name: Enable synthetic magnetometer Z component measurement
parameters.description: Use for vehicles where the measured body Z magnetic field is subject to strong magnetic interference. For magnetic heading fusion the magnetometer Z measurement will be replaced by a synthetic value calculated using the knowledge of the 3D magnetic field vector at the location of the drone. Therefore, this parameter will only have an effect if the global position of the drone is known. For 3D mag fusion the magnetometer Z measurement will simply be ignored instead of fusing the synthetic value.

parameters.name: EKF2_TAS_GATE
parameters.description: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

parameters.name: EKF2_TAU_POS
parameters.description: Controls how tightly the output track the EKF states

parameters.name: EKF2_TAU_VEL
parameters.display_name: Time constant of the velocity output prediction and smoothing filter
parameters.description: Time constant of the velocity output prediction and smoothing filter

parameters.name: EKF2_TERR_GRAD
parameters.description: Magnitude of terrain gradient

parameters.name: EKF2_TERR_NOISE
parameters.description: Terrain altitude process noise

parameters.name: EKF2_VEL_LIM
parameters.description: Velocity limit

parameters.name: EKF2_WIND_NSD
parameters.display_name: Process noise spectral density for wind velocity prediction
parameters.description: When unaided, the wind estimate uncertainty (1-sigma, in m/s) increases by this amount every second.

parameters.name: ESC_TEMP_WARN_TH
parameters.description:
Warning only, no failsafe or arming blocked.
-1 disables the check.

parameters.name: EV_TSK_RC_LOSS
parameters.description:
Enable/disable event task for RC Loss. When enabled, an alarm tune will be
played via buzzer or ESCs, if supported. The alarm will sound after a disarm,
if the vehicle was previously armed and only if the vehicle had RC signal at
some point. Particularly useful for locating crashed drones without a GPS
sensor.

parameters.name: EV_TSK_STAT_DIS
parameters.description:
Enable/disable event task for displaying the vehicle status using arm-mounted
LEDs. When enabled and if the vehicle supports it, LEDs will flash
indicating various vehicle status changes. Currently PX4 has not implemented
any specific status events.

parameters.name: FD_ACT_EN
parameters.description:
If enabled, the HealthAndArmingChecks will verify that for motors, a minimum amount of ESC current per throttle
level is being consumed.
Otherwise this indicates an motor failure.
This check only works for ESCs that report current consumption.

parameters.name: FD_ALT_LOSS
parameters.display_name: Altitude loss threshold for termination and parachute deployment
parameters.description: Maximum altitude loss below the setpoint allowed before the vehicle terminates and deploys the parachute. Set to 0 to disable.

parameters.name: FD_ALT_LOSS_T
parameters.description: Seconds that the altitude loss threshold must be exceeded before the failure is declared.

parameters.name: FD_EXT_ATS_EN
parameters.display_name: Enable PWM input from external ATS for failsafe
parameters.description:
Enable PWM input on for engaging failsafe from an external automatic trigger system (ATS)

Enabled on either AUX5 or MAIN5 depending on board.
External ATS is required by ASTM F3322-18.

parameters.name: FD_EXT_ATS_TRIG
parameters.display_name: External ATS PWM threshold for failsafe
parameters.description:
The PWM threshold from external automatic trigger system for engaging failsafe

External ATS is required by ASTM F3322-18.

parameters.name: FD_FAIL_P
parameters.description:
Maximum pitch angle before FailureDetector triggers the attitude_failure flag.
The flag triggers flight termination (if @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM = 0),
which sets outputs to their failsafe values.
On takeoff the flag triggers lockdown (irrespective of @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM),
which disarms motors but does not set outputs to failsafe values.

Setting this parameter to 0 disables the check

parameters.name: FD_FAIL_P_TTRI
parameters.description: Seconds (decimal) that pitch has to exceed FD_FAIL_P before being considered as a failure.

parameters.name: FD_FAIL_R
parameters.description:
Maximum roll angle before FailureDetector triggers the attitude_failure flag.
The flag triggers flight termination (if @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM = 0),
which sets outputs to their failsafe values.
On takeoff the flag triggers lockdown (irrespective of @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM),
which disarms motors but does not set outputs to failsafe values.

Setting this parameter to 0 disables the check

parameters.name: FD_FAIL_R_TTRI
parameters.description: Seconds (decimal) that roll has to exceed FD_FAIL_R before being considered as a failure.

parameters.name: FD_IMB_PROP_THR
parameters.description:
Value at which the imbalanced propeller metric (based on horizontal and
vertical acceleration variance) triggers a failure

Setting this value to 0 disables the feature.

parameters.name: FLW_TGT_ALT_M
parameters.description:
Maintain altitude or track target's altitude. When maintaining the altitude,
the drone can crash into terrain when the target moves uphill. When tracking
the target's altitude, the follow altitude FLW_TGT_HT should be high enough
to prevent terrain collisions due to GPS inaccuracies of the target.

values.0: 2D Tracking: Maintain constant altitude relative to home and track XY position only
values.1: 2D + Terrain: Maintain constant altitude relative to terrain below and track XY position
values.2: 3D Tracking: Track target's altitude (be aware that GPS altitude bias usually makes this useless)

parameters.name: FLW_TGT_DST
parameters.description: The distance in meters to follow the target at

parameters.name: FLW_TGT_FA
parameters.description:
Angle to follow the target from. 0.0 Equals straight in front of the target's
course (direction of motion) and the angle increases in clockwise direction,
meaning Right-side would be 90.0 degrees while Left-side is -90.0 degrees

Note: When the user force sets the angle out of the min/max range, it will be
wrapped (e.g. 480 -> 120) in the range to gracefully handle the out of range.

parameters.name: FLW_TGT_HT
parameters.description: Following height above the target

parameters.name: FLW_TGT_MAX_VEL
parameters.display_name: Max tangential velocity for follow orbit trajectory
parameters.description:
Maximum tangential velocity setting for generating the follow orbit trajectory

This is the maximum tangential velocity the drone will circle around the target whenever
an orbit angle setpoint changes. Higher value means more aggressive follow behavior.

parameters.name: FLW_TGT_RS
parameters.display_name: Responsiveness to target movement in Target Estimator
parameters.description: lower values increase the responsiveness to changing position, but also ignore less noise

parameters.name: FW_ACRO_X_MAX
parameters.display_name: Acro body roll max rate setpoint
parameters.description: Acro body roll max rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_ACRO_YAW_EN
parameters.display_name: Enable yaw rate controller in Acro
parameters.description:
If this parameter is set to 1, the yaw rate controller is enabled in Fixed-wing Acro mode.
Otherwise the pilot commands directly the yaw actuator.
It is disabled by default because an active yaw rate controller will fight against the
natural turn coordination of the plane.

parameters.name: FW_ACRO_Y_MAX
parameters.display_name: Acro body pitch max rate setpoint
parameters.description: Acro body pitch max rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_ACRO_Z_MAX
parameters.display_name: Acro body yaw max rate setpoint
parameters.description: Acro body yaw max rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_AIRSPD_FLP_SC
parameters.description: Factor applied to the minimum and stall airspeed when flaps are fully deployed.

parameters.name: FW_AIRSPD_MAX
parameters.description: The maximal airspeed (calibrated airspeed) the user is able to command.

parameters.name: FW_AIRSPD_MIN
parameters.description:
The minimal airspeed (calibrated airspeed) the user is able to command.
Further, if the airspeed falls below this value, the TECS controller will try to
increase airspeed more aggressively.
Has to be set according to the vehicle's stall speed (which should be set in FW_AIRSPD_STALL),
with some margin between the stall speed and minimum airspeed.
This value corresponds to the desired minimum speed with the default load factor (level flight, default weight),
and is automatically adpated to the current load factor (calculated from roll setpoint and WEIGHT_GROSS/WEIGHT_BASE).

parameters.name: FW_AIRSPD_STALL
parameters.description:
The stall airspeed (calibrated airspeed) of the vehicle.
It is used for airspeed sensor failure detection and for the control
surface scaling airspeed limits.

parameters.name: FW_AIRSPD_TRIM
parameters.description:
The trim CAS (calibrated airspeed) of the vehicle. If an airspeed controller is active,
this is the default airspeed setpoint that the controller will try to achieve.
This value corresponds to the trim airspeed with the default load factor (level flight, default weight).

parameters.name: FW_ARSP_SCALE_EN
parameters.description:
This enables a logic that automatically adjusts the output of the rate controller to take
into account the real torque produced by an aerodynamic control surface given
the current deviation from the trim airspeed (FW_AIRSPD_TRIM).

Enable when using aerodynamic control surfaces (e.g.: plane)
Disable when using rotor wings (e.g.: autogyro)

parameters.name: FW_AT_APPLY
parameters.display_name: Controls when to apply the new gains
parameters.description:
After the auto-tuning sequence is completed,
a new set of gains is available and can be applied
immediately or after landing.

values.0: Do not apply the new gains (logging only)
values.1: Apply the new gains after disarm
values.2: Apply the new gains in air

parameters.name: FW_AT_AXES
parameters.description:
Defines which axes will be tuned during the auto-tuning sequence

Set bits in the following positions to enable:
0 : Roll
1 : Pitch
2 : Yaw

parameters.name: FW_AT_MAN_AUX
parameters.display_name: Enable/disable auto tuning using a manual control AUX input
parameters.description: Defines which RC_MAP_AUXn parameter maps the manual control channel used to enable/disable auto tuning.

parameters.name: FW_AT_SYSID_F0
parameters.display_name: Start frequency of the injected signal
parameters.description: Can be set lower or higher than the end frequency

parameters.name: FW_AT_SYSID_F1
parameters.display_name: End frequency of the injected signal
parameters.description: Can be set lower or higher than the start frequency

parameters.name: FW_AT_SYSID_TIME
parameters.description: Duration of the input signal sent on each axis during system identification

parameters.name: FW_AT_SYSID_TYPE
parameters.description: Type of signal used during system identification to excite the system.

parameters.name: FW_BAT_SCALE_EN
parameters.display_name: Enable throttle scale by battery level
parameters.description:
This compensates for voltage drop of the battery over time by attempting to
normalize performance across the operating range of the battery.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_P_VMAX
parameters.display_name: Pitch trim increment at maximum airspeed
parameters.description: This increment is added to TRIM_PITCH when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MAX.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_P_VMIN
parameters.display_name: Pitch trim increment at minimum airspeed
parameters.description: This increment is added to TRIM_PITCH when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MIN.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_R_VMAX
parameters.display_name: Roll trim increment at maximum airspeed
parameters.description: This increment is added to TRIM_ROLL when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MAX.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_R_VMIN
parameters.display_name: Roll trim increment at minimum airspeed
parameters.description: This increment is added to TRIM_ROLL when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MIN.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_Y_VMAX
parameters.display_name: Yaw trim increment at maximum airspeed
parameters.description: This increment is added to TRIM_YAW when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MAX.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_Y_VMIN
parameters.display_name: Yaw trim increment at minimum airspeed
parameters.description: This increment is added to TRIM_YAW when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MIN.

parameters.name: FW_FLAPS_LND_SCL
parameters.description:
Sets a fraction of full flaps during landing.
Also applies to flaperons if enabled in the mixer/allocation.

parameters.name: FW_FLAPS_MAN
parameters.description: Chose source for manual setting of flaps in manual flight modes.

parameters.name: FW_FLAPS_TO_SCL
parameters.description:
Sets a fraction of full flaps during take-off.
Also applies to flaperons if enabled in the mixer/allocation.

parameters.name: FW_GC_EN
parameters.description: Enable rate gain compression

parameters.name: FW_GC_GAIN_MIN
parameters.description: The range of the compression gain is between this parameter and 1.0

parameters.name: FW_GND_SPD_MIN
parameters.description:
The controller will increase the commanded airspeed to maintain
this minimum groundspeed to the next waypoint.

parameters.name: FW_GPSF_LT
parameters.description:
The time the system should do open loop loiter and wait for GPS recovery
before it starts descending. Set to 0 to disable. Roll angle is set to FW_GPSF_R.
Does only apply for fixed-wing vehicles or VTOLs with NAV_FORCE_VT set to 0.

parameters.name: FW_GPSF_R
parameters.description: Roll angle in GPS failure loiter mode.

parameters.name: FW_LAUN_AC_T
parameters.description: Launch is detected when the norm of body acceleration is above FW_LAUN_AC_THLD for FW_LAUN_AC_T seconds.

parameters.name: FW_LAUN_AC_THLD
parameters.description: Launch is detected when the norm of body acceleration is above FW_LAUN_AC_THLD for FW_LAUN_AC_T seconds.

parameters.name: FW_LAUN_CS_LK_DY
parameters.description:
Locks control surfaces during pre-launch (armed) and until this time since launch has passed.
Only affects control surfaces that have corresponding flag set, and not active for runway takeoff.
Set to 0 to disable any surface locking after arming.

parameters.name: FW_LAUN_DETCN_ON
parameters.description:
Enables automatic launch detection based on measured acceleration. Use for hand- or catapult-launched vehicles.
Not compatible with runway takeoff.

parameters.name: FW_LAUN_MOT_DEL
parameters.description: Start the motor(s) this amount of seconds after launch is detected.

parameters.name: FW_LND_ABORT
parameters.display_name: Bit mask to set the automatic landing abort conditions
parameters.description:
Terrain estimation:
bit 0: Abort if terrain is not found
bit 1: Abort if terrain times out (after a first successful measurement)

The last estimate is always used as ground, whether the last valid measurement or the land waypoint, depending on the
selected abort criteria, until an abort condition is entered. If FW_LND_USETER == 0, these bits are ignored.

TODO: Extend automatic abort conditions
e.g. glide slope tracking error (horizontal and vertical)

bitmask.0: Abort if terrain is not found (only applies to mission landings)
bitmask.1: Abort if terrain times out (after a first successful measurement)

parameters.name: FW_LND_AIRSPD
parameters.description:
The calibrated airspeed setpoint during landing.

If set <= 0, landing airspeed = FW_AIRSPD_MIN by default.

parameters.name: FW_LND_ANG
parameters.description:
Typically the desired landing slope angle when landing configuration (flaps, airspeed) is enabled.
Set this value within the vehicle's performance limits.

parameters.name: FW_LND_EARLYCFG
parameters.description:
Allows to deploy the landing configuration (flaps, landing airspeed, etc.) already in
the loiter-down waypoint before the final approach.
Otherwise is enabled only in the final approach.

parameters.name: FW_LND_FLALT
parameters.display_name: Landing flare altitude (relative to landing altitude)
parameters.description: NOTE: max(FW_LND_FLALT, FW_LND_FL_TIME * |z-velocity|) is taken as the flare altitude

parameters.name: FW_LND_FL_PMAX
parameters.description: Maximum pitch during landing flare.

parameters.name: FW_LND_FL_PMIN
parameters.description: Minimum pitch during landing flare.

parameters.name: FW_LND_FL_SINK
parameters.description: TECS will attempt to control the aircraft to this sink rate via pitch angle (throttle killed during flare)

parameters.name: FW_LND_FL_TIME
parameters.description:
Multiplied by the descent rate to calculate a dynamic altitude at which
to trigger the flare.

NOTE: max(FW_LND_FLALT, FW_LND_FL_TIME * descent rate) is taken as the flare altitude

parameters.name: FW_LND_NUDGE
parameters.description:
Approach angle nudging: shifts the touchdown point laterally while keeping the approach entrance point constant
Approach path nudging: shifts the touchdown point laterally along with the entire approach path

This is useful for manually adjusting the landing point in real time when map or GNSS errors cause an offset from the
desired landing vector. Nudging is done with yaw stick, constrained to FW_LND_TD_OFF (in meters) and the direction is
relative to the vehicle heading (stick deflection to the right = land point moves to the right as seen by the vehicle).

parameters.name: FW_LND_TD_OFF
parameters.display_name: Maximum lateral position offset for the touchdown point
parameters.description: Maximum lateral position offset for the touchdown point

parameters.name: FW_LND_TD_TIME
parameters.description:
This is the time after the start of flaring that we expect the vehicle to touch the runway.
At this time, a 0.5s clamp down ramp will engage, constraining the pitch setpoint to RWTO_PSP.
If enabled, ensure that RWTO_PSP is configured appropriately for full gear contact on ground roll.

Set to -1.0 to disable touchdown clamping. E.g. it may not be desirable to clamp on belly landings.

The touchdown time will be constrained to be greater than or equal to the flare time (FW_LND_FL_TIME).

parameters.name: FW_LND_THRTC_SC
parameters.display_name: Altitude time constant factor for landing and low-height flight
parameters.description: The TECS altitude time constant (FW_T_ALT_TC) is multiplied by this value.

parameters.name: FW_LND_USETER
parameters.description:
This is critical for detecting when to flare, and should be enabled if possible.

If enabled and no measurement is found within a given timeout, the landing waypoint altitude will be used OR the landing
will be aborted, depending on the criteria set in FW_LND_ABORT.

If disabled, FW_LND_ABORT terrain based criteria are ignored.

values.1: Use the terrain estimate to trigger the flare (only)
values.2: Calculate landing glide slope relative to the terrain estimate

parameters.name: FW_MAN_P_MAX
parameters.description: Applies to both directions in all manual modes with attitude stabilization but without altitude control

parameters.name: FW_MAN_P_SC
parameters.description:
Scale factor applied to the desired pitch actuator command in full manual mode. This parameter allows
to adjust the throws of the control surfaces.

parameters.name: FW_MAN_R_MAX
parameters.description: Applies to both directions in all manual modes with attitude stabilization

parameters.name: FW_MAN_R_SC
parameters.description:
Scale factor applied to the desired roll actuator command in full manual mode. This parameter allows
to adjust the throws of the control surfaces.

parameters.name: FW_MAN_YR_MAX
parameters.description:
This is the maximally added yaw rate setpoint from the yaw stick in any attitude controlled flight mode.
It is added to the yaw rate setpoint generated by the controller for turn coordination.

parameters.name: FW_MAN_Y_SC
parameters.description:
Scale factor applied to the desired yaw actuator command in full manual mode. This parameter allows
to adjust the throws of the control surfaces.

parameters.name: FW_PN_R_SLEW_MAX
parameters.display_name: Path navigation roll slew rate limit
parameters.description:
Maximum change in roll angle setpoint per second.
Applied in all Auto modes, plus manual Position & Altitude modes.

parameters.name: FW_POS_STK_CONF
parameters.description: Applies in manual Position and Altitude flight modes.

bitmask.0: Alternative stick configuration (height rate on throttle stick, airspeed on pitch stick)
bitmask.1: Enable airspeed setpoint via sticks in altitude and position flight mode

parameters.name: FW_PR_D
parameters.description: Pitch rate differential gain.

parameters.name: FW_PR_FF
parameters.description:
Direct feed forward from rate setpoint to torque setpoint.
Positive values compensate aerodynamic damping (scaled linearly with airspeed).
Negative values reduce setpoint tracking aggressiveness while preserving disturbance rejection (2-DOF controller, scaled quadratically with airspeed)

parameters.name: FW_PR_I
parameters.description: Pitch rate integrator gain

parameters.name: FW_PR_IMAX
parameters.description: Pitch rate integrator limit

parameters.name: FW_PR_P
parameters.description: Pitch rate proportional gain

parameters.name: FW_PSP_OFF
parameters.display_name: Pitch setpoint offset (pitch at level flight)
parameters.description:
An airframe specific offset of the pitch setpoint in degrees, the value is
added to the pitch setpoint and should correspond to the pitch at
typical cruise speed of the airframe.

parameters.name: FW_P_LIM_MAX
parameters.description: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.

parameters.name: FW_P_LIM_MIN
parameters.description: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.

parameters.name: FW_P_RMAX_NEG
parameters.display_name: Maximum negative / down pitch rate setpoint
parameters.description: Maximum negative / down pitch rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_P_RMAX_POS
parameters.display_name: Maximum positive / up pitch rate setpoint
parameters.description: Maximum positive / up pitch rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_P_TC
parameters.description:
This defines the latency between a pitch step input and the achieved setpoint
(inverse to a P gain). Smaller systems may require smaller values.

parameters.name: FW_RLL_TO_YAW_FF
parameters.display_name: Roll control to yaw control feedforward gain
parameters.description:
This gain can be used to counteract the "adverse yaw" effect for fixed wings.
When the plane enters a roll it will tend to yaw the nose out of the turn.
This gain enables the use of a yaw actuator to counteract this effect.

parameters.name: FW_RR_D
parameters.description: Roll rate derivative gain

parameters.name: FW_RR_FF
parameters.description:
Direct feed forward from rate setpoint to torque setpoint.
Positive values compensate aerodynamic damping (scaled linearly with airspeed).
Negative values reduce setpoint tracking aggressiveness while preserving disturbance rejection (2-DOF controller, scaled quadratically with airspeed)

parameters.name: FW_RR_I
parameters.description: Roll rate integrator gain

parameters.name: FW_RR_IMAX
parameters.description: Roll integrator limit

parameters.name: FW_RR_P
parameters.description: Roll rate proportional gain

parameters.name: FW_R_LIM
parameters.description: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.

parameters.name: FW_R_RMAX
parameters.description: Maximum roll rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_R_TC
parameters.description:
This defines the latency between a roll step input and the achieved setpoint
(inverse to a P gain). Smaller systems may require smaller values.

parameters.name: FW_SERVICE_CEIL
parameters.description:
Altitude in standard atmosphere at which the vehicle in normal configuration (WEIGHT_BASE) is still able to achieve a maximum climb rate of
0.5m/s at maximum throttle (FW_THR_MAX). Used to compensate for air density in FW_T_CLMB_MAX.
Set negative to disable.

parameters.name: FW_SPOILERS_LND
parameters.description: Spoiler landing setting

parameters.name: FW_SPOILERS_MAN
parameters.description: Chose source for manual setting of spoilers in manual flight modes.

parameters.name: FW_THR_ASPD_MAX
parameters.description:
Required throttle (at sea level, standard atmosphere) for level flight at maximum airspeed FW_AIRSPD_MAX

Set to 0 to disable mapping of airspeed to trim throttle.

parameters.name: FW_THR_ASPD_MIN
parameters.description:
Required throttle (at sea level, standard atmosphere) for level flight at minimum airspeed FW_AIRSPD_MIN

Set to 0 to disable mapping of airspeed to trim throttle below FW_AIRSPD_TRIM.

parameters.name: FW_THR_IDLE
parameters.description: This is the minimum throttle while on the ground ("landed") in auto modes.

parameters.name: FW_THR_MAX
parameters.description:
Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.
Should be set accordingly to achieve FW_T_CLMB_MAX.

parameters.name: FW_THR_MIN
parameters.description:
Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.
Usually set to 0 but can be increased to prevent the motor from stopping when
descending, which can increase achievable descent rates.

parameters.name: FW_THR_SLEW_MAX
parameters.description: Maximum slew rate for the commanded throttle

parameters.name: FW_THR_TRIM
parameters.description: Required throttle (at sea level, standard atmosphere) for level flight at FW_AIRSPD_TRIM

parameters.name: FW_TKO_AIRSPD
parameters.description:
The calibrated airspeed setpoint during the takeoff climbout.

If set <= 0, FW_AIRSPD_MIN will be set by default.

parameters.name: FW_TKO_PITCH_MIN
parameters.description: Minimum pitch during takeoff

parameters.name: FW_T_ALT_TC
parameters.description: Altitude error time constant

parameters.name: FW_T_CLMB_MAX
parameters.description:
This is the maximum calibrated climb rate that the aircraft can achieve with
the throttle set to FW_THR_MAX and the airspeed set to the
trim value. For electric aircraft make sure this number can be
achieved towards the end of flight when the battery voltage has reduced.

parameters.name: FW_T_CLMB_R_SP
parameters.description:
In auto modes: default climb rate output by controller to achieve altitude setpoints.
In manual modes: maximum climb rate setpoint.

parameters.name: FW_T_F_ALT_ERR
parameters.description:
Minimum altitude error needed to descend with max airspeed and minimal throttle.
A negative value disables fast descend.

parameters.name: FW_T_HRATE_FF
parameters.description: Height rate feed forward

parameters.name: FW_T_I_GAIN_PIT
parameters.description:
Increase it to trim out speed and height offsets faster,
with the downside of possible overshoots and oscillations.

parameters.name: FW_T_PTCH_DAMP
parameters.description: Pitch damping gain

parameters.name: FW_T_RLL2THR
parameters.description:
Is used to compensate for the additional drag created by turning.
Increase this gain if the aircraft initially loses energy in turns
and reduce if the aircraft initially gains energy in turns.

parameters.name: FW_T_SEB_R_FF
parameters.display_name: Specific total energy balance rate feedforward gain
parameters.description: Specific total energy balance rate feedforward gain

parameters.name: FW_T_SINK_MAX
parameters.description: Maximum descent rate

parameters.name: FW_T_SINK_MIN
parameters.description:
This is the minimum calibrated sink rate of the aircraft with the throttle
set to THR_MIN and flown at the same airspeed as used
to measure FW_T_CLMB_MAX.

parameters.name: FW_T_SINK_R_SP
parameters.description:
In auto modes: default sink rate output by controller to achieve altitude setpoints.
In manual modes: maximum sink rate setpoint.

parameters.name: FW_T_SPDWEIGHT
parameters.description:
Adjusts the amount of weighting that the pitch control
applies to speed vs height errors.
0 -> control height only
2 -> control speed only (gliders)

parameters.name: FW_T_STE_R_TC
parameters.display_name: Specific total energy rate first order filter time constant
parameters.description: This filter is applied to the specific total energy rate used for throttle damping.

parameters.name: FW_T_TAS_TC
parameters.description: True airspeed error time constant

parameters.name: FW_T_THR_DAMPING
parameters.description: This is the damping gain for the throttle demand loop.

parameters.name: FW_T_THR_INTEG
parameters.description:
Increase it to trim out speed and height offsets faster,
with the downside of possible overshoots and oscillations.

parameters.name: FW_T_THR_LOW_HGT
parameters.display_name: Low-height threshold for tighter altitude tracking
parameters.description:
Height above ground threshold below which tighter altitude
tracking gets enabled (see FW_LND_THRTC_SC). Below this height, TECS smoothly
(1 sec / sec) transitions the altitude tracking time constant from FW_T_ALT_TC
to FW_LND_THRTC_SC*FW_T_ALT_TC.

-1 to disable.

parameters.name: FW_T_VERT_ACC
parameters.description:
This is the maximum vertical acceleration
either up or down that the controller will use to correct speed
or height errors.

parameters.name: FW_USE_AIRSPD
parameters.description:
If set to 1, the airspeed measurement data, if valid, is used in the following controllers:
- Rate controller: output scaling
- Attitude controller: coordinated turn controller
- Position controller: airspeed setpoint tracking, takeoff logic
- VTOL: transition logic

parameters.name: FW_WIND_ARSP_SC
parameters.description:
Multiplying this factor with the current absolute wind estimate gives the airspeed offset
added to the minimum airspeed setpoint limit. This helps to make the
system more robust against disturbances (turbulence) in high wind.

parameters.name: FW_WING_HEIGHT
parameters.display_name: Height (AGL) of the wings when the aircraft is on the ground
parameters.description:
This is used to constrain a minimum altitude below which we keep wings level to avoid wing tip strike. It's safer
to give a slight margin here (> 0m)

parameters.name: FW_WING_SPAN
parameters.display_name: The aircraft's wing span (length from tip to tip)
parameters.description: This is used for limiting the roll setpoint near the ground. (if multiple wings, take the longest span)

parameters.name: FW_WP_RST_DIST
parameters.description:
If a horizontal position reset larger than this occurs while flying between two
waypoints, fly directly to the current waypoint instead of rejoining the line.
-1 to disable.

parameters.name: FW_WR_FF
parameters.description: Wheel steering rate feed forward

parameters.name: FW_WR_I
parameters.description:
This gain defines how much control response will result out of a steady
state error. It trims any constant error.

parameters.name: FW_WR_IMAX
parameters.description: Wheel steering rate integrator limit

parameters.name: FW_WR_P
parameters.description:
This defines how much the wheel steering input will be commanded depending on the
current body angular rate error.

parameters.name: FW_W_EN
parameters.description:
Only enabled during automatic runway takeoff and landing.
In all manual modes the wheel is directly controlled with yaw stick.

parameters.name: FW_W_RMAX
parameters.description:
This limits the maximum wheel steering rate the controller will output (in degrees per
second).

parameters.name: FW_YR_D
parameters.description: Yaw rate derivative gain

parameters.name: FW_YR_FF
parameters.description:
Direct feed forward from rate setpoint to torque setpoint.
Positive values compensate aerodynamic damping (scaled linearly with airspeed).
Negative values reduce setpoint tracking aggressiveness while preserving disturbance rejection (2-DOF controller, scaled quadratically with airspeed)

parameters.name: FW_YR_I
parameters.description: Yaw rate integrator gain

parameters.name: FW_YR_IMAX
parameters.description: Yaw rate integrator limit

parameters.name: FW_YR_P
parameters.description: Yaw rate proportional gain

parameters.name: FW_Y_RMAX
parameters.description: Maximum yaw rate setpoint

parameters.name: GF_ACTION
parameters.description:
Note: Setting this value to 4 enables flight termination,
which will kill the vehicle on violation of the fence.

parameters.name: GF_MAX_HOR_DIST
parameters.description:
Maximum horizontal distance in meters the vehicle can be from Home before triggering a geofence action.
Disabled if 0.

parameters.name: GF_MAX_VER_DIST
parameters.description:
Maximum vertical distance in meters the vehicle can be from Home before triggering a geofence action.
Disabled if 0.

parameters.name: GF_SOURCE
parameters.description:
Select which position source should be used. Selecting GPS instead of global position makes sure that there is
no dependence on the position estimator
0 = global position, 1 = GPS

parameters.name: GPS_1_GNSS
parameters.display_name: GNSS Systems for Primary GPS (integer bitmask)
parameters.description:
This integer bitmask controls the set of GNSS systems used by the receiver. Check your
receiver's documentation on how many systems are supported to be used in parallel.

Currently this functionality is just implemented for u-blox receivers.

When no bits are set, the receiver's default configuration should be used.

Set bits true to enable:
0 : Use GPS (with QZSS)
1 : Use SBAS (multiple GPS augmentation systems)
2 : Use Galileo
3 : Use BeiDou
4 : Use GLONASS
5 : Use NAVIC

parameters.name: GPS_1_PROTOCOL
parameters.description:
Select the GPS protocol over serial.

Auto-detection will probe all protocols, and thus is a bit slower.

parameters.name: GPS_2_GNSS
parameters.display_name: GNSS Systems for Secondary GPS (integer bitmask)
parameters.description:
This integer bitmask controls the set of GNSS systems used by the receiver. Check your
receiver's documentation on how many systems are supported to be used in parallel.

Currently this functionality is just implemented for u-blox receivers.

When no bits are set, the receiver's default configuration should be used.

Set bits true to enable:
0 : Use GPS (with QZSS)
1 : Use SBAS (multiple GPS augmentation systems)
2 : Use Galileo
3 : Use BeiDou
4 : Use GLONASS
5 : Use NAVIC

parameters.name: GPS_2_PROTOCOL
parameters.description:
Select the GPS protocol over serial.

Auto-detection will probe all protocols, and thus is a bit slower.

parameters.name: GPS_CFG_WIPE
parameters.display_name: Wipes the flash config of UBX modules
parameters.description:
Some UBX modules have a FLASH that allows to store persistent configuration that will be loaded on start.
PX4 does override all configuration parameters it needs in RAM, which takes precedence over the values in FLASH.
However, configuration parameters that are not overridden by PX4 can still cause unexpected problems during flight.
To avoid these kind of problems a clean config can be reached by wiping the FLASH on boot.

Note: Currently only supported on UBX.

parameters.name: GPS_DUMP_COMM
parameters.description:
If this is set to 1, all GPS communication data will be published via uORB,
and written to the log file as gps_dump message.

If this is set to 2, the main GPS is configured to output RTCM data,
which is then logged as gps_dump and can be used for PPK.

parameters.name: GPS_SAT_INFO
parameters.description:
Enable publication of satellite info (ORB_ID(satellite_info)) if possible.
Not available on MTK.

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_BAUD1
parameters.description:
Baudrate applied to the receiver UART1 after the link is auto-detected.
0 keeps the driver default (115200). Modes that share UART1 with RTCM
(GPS_UBX_MODE 3/4) may need a higher rate on short/reliable links.

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_BAUD2
parameters.description: Baudrate for the receiver UART2 port.

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_CFG_INTF
parameters.description: u-blox protocol configuration for interfaces

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_DGNSS_TO
parameters.description: When set to 0 (default), default DGNSS timeout set by u-blox will be used.

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_DYNMODEL
parameters.description:
u-blox receivers support different dynamic platform models to adjust the navigation engine to
the expected application environment.

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_JAM_DET
parameters.display_name: u-blox GPS jamming detection high sensitivity mode
parameters.description:
Enables or disables the high sensitivity mode for the u-blox jamming detection
(CFG-SEC-JAMDET_SENSITIVITY_HI). When enabled, the receiver uses a
more sensitive algorithm to detect jamming. Disabling this may reduce false
positives in electrically noisy environments.

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_MIN_CNO
parameters.display_name: u-blox GPS minimum satellite signal level for navigation
parameters.description: When set to 0 (default), default minimum satellite signal level set by u-blox wll be used.

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_MIN_ELEV
parameters.display_name: u-blox GPS minimum satellite elevation angle
parameters.description:
u-blox GPS minimum elevation for a GNSS satellite to be used in navigation

When set to 0 (default), default minimum elevation set by u-blox will be used.

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_MODE
parameters.description:
Select the u-blox configuration setup. Most setups will use the default, including RTK and
dual GPS without heading.

If rover has RTCM corrections from a static base (or other static correction source) coming in on UART2, then select Mode 5.
The Heading mode requires 2 F9P devices to be attached. The main GPS will act as rover and output
heading information, whereas the secondary will act as moving base.
Modes 1 and 2 require each F9P UART1 to be connected to the Autopilot. In addition, UART2 on the
F9P units are connected to each other.
Modes 3 and 4 only require UART1 on each F9P connected to the Autopilot or Can Node. UART RX DMA is required.
RTK is still possible with this setup.
Mode 6 is intended for use with a ground control station (not necessarily an RTK correction base).

values.1: Heading (Rover With Moving Base UART1 Connected To Autopilot, UART2 Connected To Moving Base)
values.2: Moving Base (UART1 Connected To Autopilot, UART2 Connected To Rover)
values.3: Heading (Rover With Moving Base UART1 Connected to Autopilot Or Can Node)
values.4: Moving Base (Moving Base UART1 Connected to Autopilot Or Can Node)
values.5: Rover with Static Base on UART2 (similar to Default, except coming in on UART2)

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_PPK
parameters.display_name: Enable MSM7 message output for PPK workflow
parameters.description: Enable MSM7 message output for PPK workflow

parameters.name: GPS_UBX_RATE
parameters.description:
Configure the output rate of u-blox GPS receivers (protocol v27+).
When set to 0, automatic rate selection is used based on the receiver model.
Default rates: M9N=8Hz, F9P L1L2=5Hz, F9P L1L5=5Hz, Others=10Hz.

Note: Higher rates reduce satellite count (e.g., >8Hz limits to 16 SVs on M9N).
Max rates vary by model and RTK mode: F9P L1L2=5-7Hz, F9P L1L5=7-8Hz, X20=25Hz.
High rates at 115200 baud may cause dropouts.

parameters.name: GPS_YAW_OFFSET
parameters.display_name: Heading/Yaw offset for dual antenna GPS
parameters.description:
Heading offset angle for dual antenna GPS setups that support heading estimation.

Set this to 0 if the antennas are parallel to the forward-facing direction
of the vehicle and the rover (or Unicore primary) antenna is in front.

The offset angle increases clockwise.

Set this to 90 if the rover (or Unicore primary, or Septentrio Mosaic Aux)
antenna is placed on the right side of the vehicle and the moving base
antenna is on the left side.

(Note: the Unicore primary antenna is the one connected on the right as seen
from the top).

parameters.name: HTE_ACC_GATE
parameters.description:
Sets the number of standard deviations used
by the innovation consistency test.

parameters.name: HTE_HT_ERR_INIT
parameters.description:
Initial standard deviation of the hover thrust state estimate.
Larger values allow the estimate to move farther from the initial
hover thrust before process noise takes over.

parameters.name: HTE_HT_NOISE
parameters.description:
Reduce to make the hover thrust estimate
more stable, increase if the real hover thrust
is expected to change quickly over time.

parameters.name: HTE_THR_RANGE
parameters.description:
Defines the range of the hover thrust estimate around MPC_THR_HOVER.
A value of 0.2 with MPC_THR_HOVER at 0.5 results in a range of [0.3, 0.7].

Set to a large value if the vehicle operates in varying physical conditions that
affect the required hover thrust strongly (e.g. differently sized payloads).

parameters.name: HTE_VXY_THR
parameters.display_name: Horizontal velocity threshold for sensitivity reduction
parameters.description:
Above this speed, the measurement noise is linearly increased
to reduce the sensitivity of the estimator from biased measurement.

Set to a low value on vehicles with large lifting surfaces.

parameters.name: HTE_VZ_THR
parameters.display_name: Vertical velocity threshold for sensitivity reduction
parameters.description:
Above this speed, the measurement noise is linearly increased
to reduce the sensitivity of the estimator from biased measurement.

Set to a low value on vehicles affected by air drag when climbing or descending.

parameters.name: IMU_ACCEL_CUTOFF
parameters.display_name: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for accel
parameters.description:
The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter on the primary accelerometer.
This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators. 0 disables the filter.

parameters.name: IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF
parameters.display_name: Cutoff frequency for angular acceleration (D-Term filter)
parameters.description:
The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter used on
the time derivative of the measured angular velocity, also known as
the D-term filter in the rate controller. The D-term uses the derivative of
the rate and thus is the most susceptible to noise. Therefore, using
a D-term filter allows to increase IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF, which
leads to reduced control latency and permits to increase the P gains.

A value of 0 disables the filter.

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_CAL_EN
parameters.description: IMU gyro auto calibration enable

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF
parameters.display_name: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for gyro
parameters.description:
The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter on the primary gyro.
This only affects the angular velocity sent to the controllers, not the estimators.
It applies also to the angular acceleration (D-Term filter), see IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF.

A value of 0 disables the filter.

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_DNF_BW
parameters.display_name: IMU gyro ESC notch filter bandwidth
parameters.description: Bandwidth per notch filter when using dynamic notch filtering with ESC RPM.

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_DNF_EN
parameters.description:
Enable bank of dynamically updating notch filters.
Requires ESC RPM feedback or onboard FFT (IMU_GYRO_FFT_EN).

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_DNF_HMC
parameters.display_name: IMU gyro dynamic notch filter harmonics
parameters.description: ESC RPM number of harmonics (multiples of RPM) for ESC RPM dynamic notch filtering.

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_DNF_MIN
parameters.display_name: IMU gyro dynamic notch filter minimum frequency
parameters.description: Minimum notch filter frequency in Hz.

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_FFT_EN
parameters.description: IMU gyro FFT enable

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_FFT_LEN
parameters.description: IMU gyro FFT length

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_FFT_MAX
parameters.description: IMU gyro FFT maximum frequency

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_FFT_MIN
parameters.description: IMU gyro FFT minimum frequency

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_FFT_SNR
parameters.description: IMU gyro FFT SNR

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_NF0_BW
parameters.description:
The frequency width of the stop band for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF0_FRQ" to activate the filter and to set the notch frequency.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_NF0_FRQ
parameters.description:
The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
This filter can be enabled to avoid feedback amplification of structural resonances at a specific frequency.
This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF0_BW" to set the bandwidth of the filter.

A value of 0 disables the filter.

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_NF1_BW
parameters.description:
The frequency width of the stop band for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF1_FRQ" to activate the filter and to set the notch frequency.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_NF1_FRQ
parameters.description:
The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
This filter can be enabled to avoid feedback amplification of structural resonances at a specific frequency.
This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF1_BW" to set the bandwidth of the filter.

A value of 0 disables the filter.

parameters.name: IMU_GYRO_RATEMAX
parameters.display_name: Gyro control data maximum publication rate (inner loop rate)
parameters.description:
The maximum rate the gyro control data (vehicle_angular_velocity) will be
allowed to publish at. This is the loop rate for the rate controller and outputs.

Note: sensor data is always read and filtered at the full raw rate (eg commonly 8 kHz) regardless of this setting.

parameters.name: IMU_INTEG_RATE
parameters.description:
The rate at which raw IMU data is integrated to produce delta angles and delta velocities.
Recommended to set this to a multiple of the estimator update period (currently 10 ms for ekf2).

parameters.name: LNDFW_AIRSPD_MAX
parameters.description: Maximum airspeed allowed in the landed state

parameters.name: LNDFW_ROT_MAX
parameters.display_name: Fixed-wing land detector: max rotational speed
parameters.description:
Maximum allowed norm of the angular velocity in the landed state.
Only used if neither airspeed nor groundspeed can be used for landing detection.

parameters.name: LNDFW_TRIG_TIME
parameters.description: Time the land conditions (speeds and acceleration) have to be satisfied to detect a landing.

parameters.name: LNDFW_VEL_XY_MAX
parameters.display_name: Fixed-wing land detector: Max horizontal velocity threshold
parameters.description:
Maximum horizontal velocity allowed in the landed state.
A factor of 0.7 is applied in case of airspeed-less flying
(either because no sensor is present or sensor data got invalid in flight).

parameters.name: LNDFW_VEL_Z_MAX
parameters.display_name: Fixed-wing land detector: Max vertiacal velocity threshold
parameters.description: Maximum vertical velocity allowed in the landed state.

parameters.name: LNDFW_XYACC_MAX
parameters.display_name: Fixed-wing land detector: Max horizontal acceleration
parameters.description: Maximum gravity-compensated horizontal (earth frame) acceleration allowed in the landed state.

parameters.name: LNDMC_ALT_GND
parameters.description:
The height above ground below which ground effect creates barometric altitude errors.
A negative value indicates no ground effect.

parameters.name: LNDMC_ROT_MAX
parameters.description: Maximum allowed norm of the angular velocity (roll, pitch) in the landed state.

parameters.name: LNDMC_XY_VEL_MAX
parameters.description: Maximum horizontal velocity allowed in the landed state

parameters.name: LNDMC_Z_VEL_MAX
parameters.description:
Vertical velocity threshold to detect landing.
Has to be set lower than the expected minimal speed for landing,
which is either MPC_LAND_SPEED or MPC_LAND_CRWL.
This is enforced by an automatic check.

parameters.name: LND_FLIGHT_T_HI
parameters.description:
Total flight time of this autopilot. Higher 32 bits of the value.
Flight time in microseconds = (LND_FLIGHT_T_HI << 32) | LND_FLIGHT_T_LO.

parameters.name: LND_FLIGHT_T_LO
parameters.description:
Total flight time of this autopilot. Lower 32 bits of the value.
Flight time in microseconds = (LND_FLIGHT_T_HI << 32) | LND_FLIGHT_T_LO.

parameters.name: LPE_FUSION
parameters.description:
Set bits in the following positions to enable:
0 : Set to true to fuse GPS data if available, also requires GPS for altitude init

default (145 - GPS, baro, land detector)

parameters.name: MAN_ARM_GESTURE
parameters.description:
This determines if moving the left stick to the lower right
arms and to the lower left disarms the vehicle.

parameters.name: MAN_DEADZONE
parameters.display_name: Deadzone for sticks (only specific use cases)
parameters.description:
Range around stick center ignored to prevent
vehicle drift from stick hardware inaccuracy.

Does not apply to any precise constant input like
throttle and attitude or rate piloting.

parameters.name: MAN_KILL_GEST_T
parameters.display_name: Trigger time for kill stick gesture
parameters.description:
The timeout for holding the left stick to the lower left
and the right stick to the lower right at the same time until the gesture
kills the actuators one-way.

A negative value disables the feature.

parameters.name: MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD
parameters.description: Stick velocity above which the pilot regains control by switching to Position mode (or Altitude if position is unavailable). Unit: normalized stick travel per second — at 1.0, moving a stick half its range in ~0.5s triggers it. A negative value disables the feature. Only applies to multicopters and VTOLs in MC mode.

parameters.name: MAV_0_BROADCAST
parameters.display_name: Broadcast heartbeats on local network for MAVLink instance 0
parameters.description:
This allows a ground control station to automatically find the drone
on the local network.

parameters.name: MAV_0_FLOW_CTRL
parameters.display_name: Enable serial flow control for instance 0
parameters.description:
This is used to force flow control on or off for the the mavlink
instance. By default it is auto detected. Use when auto detection fails.

parameters.name: MAV_0_FORWARD
parameters.display_name: Enable MAVLink Message forwarding for instance 0
parameters.description:
If enabled, forward incoming MAVLink messages to other MAVLink ports if the
message is either broadcast or the target is not the autopilot.

This allows for example a GCS to talk to a camera that is connected to the
autopilot via MAVLink (on a different link than the GCS).

parameters.name: MAV_0_HL_FREQ
parameters.display_name: Configures the frequency of HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 0
parameters.description:
Positive real value that configures the transmission frequency of the
HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 0, configured in iridium mode.
This parameter has no effect if the instance mode is different from iridium.

parameters.name: MAV_0_MODE
parameters.description:
The MAVLink Mode defines the set of streamed messages (for example the
vehicle's attitude) and their sending rates.

parameters.name: MAV_0_RADIO_CTL
parameters.display_name: Enable software throttling of mavlink on instance 0
parameters.description:
If enabled, MAVLink messages will be throttled according to
`txbuf` field reported by radio_status.

Requires a radio to send the mavlink message RADIO_STATUS.

parameters.name: MAV_0_RATE
parameters.display_name: Maximum MAVLink sending rate for instance 0
parameters.description:
Configure the maximum sending rate for the MAVLink streams in Bytes/sec.
If the configured streams exceed the maximum rate, the sending rate of
each stream is automatically decreased.

If this is set to 0 a value of half of the theoretical maximum bandwidth is used.
This corresponds to baudrate/20 Bytes/s (baudrate/10 = maximum data rate on
8N1-configured links).

parameters.name: MAV_0_REMOTE_PRT
parameters.description:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 0,
selected remote port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 0.

parameters.name: MAV_0_UDP_PRT
parameters.description:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 0,
selected udp port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 0.

parameters.description:
Exponential factor for tuning the input curve shape.

0 Purely linear input curve
1 Purely cubic input curve

parameters.name: MC_ACRO_EXPO_Y

0 Purely linear input curve
1 Purely cubic input curve

0 Pure Expo function
0.7 reasonable shape enhancement for intuitive stick feel

parameters.name: MC_ACRO_SUPEXPOY

parameters.name: MC_AIRMODE
parameters.description:
The air-mode enables the mixer to increase the total thrust of the multirotor
in order to keep attitude and rate control even at low and high throttle.

This function should be disabled during tuning as it will help the controller
to diverge if the closed-loop is unstable (i.e. the vehicle is not tuned yet).

Enabling air-mode for yaw requires the use of an arming switch.

parameters.name: MC_AT_APPLY
parameters.display_name: Controls when to apply the new gains
parameters.description:
After the auto-tuning sequence is completed,
a new set of gains is available and can be applied
immediately or after landing.

WARNING Applying the gains in air is dangerous as there is no
guarantee that those new gains will be able to stabilize
the drone properly.

values.0: Do not apply the new gains (logging only)
values.1: Apply the new gains after disarm
values.2: WARNING Apply the new gains in air

parameters.description: Amplitude of the injected signal

parameters.name: MC_BAT_SCALE_EN
parameters.description:
This compensates for voltage drop of the battery over time by attempting to
normalize performance across the operating range of the battery. The copter
should constantly behave as if it was fully charged with reduced max acceleration
at lower battery percentages. i.e. if hover is at 0.5 throttle at 100% battery,
it will still be 0.5 at 60% battery.

parameters.name: MC_MAN_TILT_TAU
parameters.display_name: Manual tilt input filter time constant
parameters.description: Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter

parameters.name: MC_ORBIT_RAD_MAX
parameters.description: Maximum radius of orbit

parameters.name: MC_ORBIT_YAW_MOD
parameters.description: Yaw behaviour during orbit flight

parameters.name: MC_PITCHRATE_D
parameters.description: Pitch rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

parameters.name: MC_PITCHRATE_FF
parameters.description: Improves tracking performance.

parameters.name: MC_PITCHRATE_I
parameters.description: Pitch rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

parameters.name: MC_PITCHRATE_K
parameters.description:
Global gain of the controller.

This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller:
```
output = MC_PITCHRATE_K * (MC_PITCHRATE_P * error
+ MC_PITCHRATE_I * error_integral
+ MC_PITCHRATE_D * error_derivative)
```
Set MC_PITCHRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form.
Set MC_PITCHRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

parameters.name: MC_PITCHRATE_MAX
parameters.description:
Limit for pitch rate in manual and auto modes (except acro).
Has effect for large rotations in autonomous mode, to avoid large control
output and mixer saturation.

This is not only limited by the vehicle's properties, but also by the maximum
measurement rate of the gyro.

parameters.name: MC_PITCHRATE_P
parameters.description: Pitch rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

parameters.name: MC_PITCH_P
parameters.description: Pitch proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

parameters.name: MC_PR_INT_LIM
parameters.description: Pitch rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large pitch moment trim changes.

parameters.name: MC_REF_FF
parameters.description: Scale on the reference-model rate feed-forward. 0 disables it.

parameters.name: MC_REF_FF_MAX
parameters.description: Per-axis cap on the rate feed-forward.

parameters.name: MC_REF_W_N
parameters.description:
Bandwidth of the reference model that smooths the attitude setpoint
and generates the rate feed-forward. Higher = less lag, more peak
rate demand.

parameters.name: MC_ROLLRATE_D
parameters.description: Roll rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

parameters.name: MC_ROLLRATE_FF
parameters.description: Improves tracking performance.

parameters.name: MC_ROLLRATE_I

parameters.name: MC_ROLLRATE_K

Global gain of the controller.

This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller:

output = MC_ROLLRATE_K * (MC_ROLLRATE_P * error

Set MC_ROLLRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form.
Set MC_ROLLRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

parameters.name: MC_ROLLRATE_MAX

Limit for roll rate in manual and auto modes (except acro).
Has effect for large rotations in autonomous mode, to avoid large control
output and mixer saturation.

This is not only limited by the vehicle's properties, but also by the maximum

parameters.name: MC_ROLLRATE_P

parameters.name: MC_ROLL_P

parameters.name: MC_RR_INT_LIM

parameters.name: MC_SLOW_DEF_HVEL

This value is used in slow mode if

parameters.name: MC_SLOW_DEF_VVEL
parameters.description:
This value is used in slow mode if

parameters.name: MC_SLOW_DEF_YAWR

This value is used in slow mode if

parameters.description: Manual input mapped to scale horizontal velocity in position slow mode

parameters.name: MC_YAWRATE_MAX
parameters.description: Max yaw rate

parameters.name: MC_YAWRATE_P
