parameters.name: MC_YAW_P
parameters.description: Yaw proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

parameters.name: MC_YAW_TQ_CUTOFF
parameters.display_name: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for yaw torque setpoint
parameters.description:
Reduces vibrations by lowering high frequency torque caused by rotor acceleration.
0 disables the filter

parameters.name: MC_YAW_WEIGHT
parameters.description:
A fraction [0,1] deprioritizing yaw compared to roll and pitch in non-linear attitude control.
Deprioritizing yaw is necessary because multicopters have much less control authority
in yaw compared to the other axes and it makes sense because yaw is not critical for
stable hovering or 3D navigation.

For yaw control tuning use MC_YAW_P. This ratio has no impact on the yaw gain.

parameters.name: MC_YR_INT_LIM
parameters.description: Yaw rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large yaw moment trim changes.

parameters.name: MIS_COMMAND_TOUT
parameters.display_name: Timeout to allow the payload to execute the mission command
parameters.description:
Ensure:
gripper: NAV_CMD_DO_GRIPPER
has released before continuing mission.
winch: CMD_DO_WINCH
has delivered before continuing mission.
gimbal: CMD_DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_PITCHYAW
has reached the commanded orientation before beginning to take pictures.

parameters.name: MIS_DIST_1WP
parameters.display_name: Maximal horizontal distance from Home to first waypoint
parameters.description:
There will be a warning message if the current waypoint is more distant than MIS_DIST_1WP from Home.
Has no effect on mission validity.
Set a value of zero or less to disable.

parameters.name: MIS_LND_ABRT_ALT
parameters.description:
Minimum altitude above landing point that the vehicle will climb to after an aborted landing.
Then vehicle will loiter in this altitude until further command is received.
Used as the default when the landing mission item does not specify its own abort altitude
(MAV_CMD_NAV_LAND param1).
Only applies to fixed-wing vehicles.

parameters.name: MIS_MNT_YAW_CTL
parameters.display_name: Enable gimbal yaw control in missions
parameters.description:
Enable yaw control of the mount. (Only affects multicopters and ROI mission items)

If enabled, yaw commands will be sent to the mount and the vehicle will follow its heading towards the flight direction.
If disabled, the vehicle will yaw towards the ROI.

parameters.name: MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT
parameters.description:
This is the relative altitude the system will take off to
if not otherwise specified.

parameters.name: MIS_TKO_LAND_REQ
parameters.description:
Specifies if a mission has to contain a takeoff and/or mission landing.
Validity of configured takeoffs/landings is checked independently of the setting here.

values.3: Require a takeoff and a landing
values.4: Require both a takeoff and a landing, or neither
values.5: Same as previous when landed, in-air require landing only if no valid VTOL approach is present

parameters.name: MIS_YAW_ERR
parameters.display_name: Max yaw error in degrees needed for waypoint heading acceptance
parameters.description: Max yaw error in degrees needed for waypoint heading acceptance

parameters.name: MIS_YAW_TMT
parameters.description:
Time in seconds we wait on reaching target heading at a waypoint if it is forced

If set > 0 it will ignore the target heading for normal waypoint acceptance. If the
waypoint forces the heading the timeout will matter. For example on VTOL forwards transition.
Mainly useful for VTOLs that have less yaw authority and might not reach target
yaw in wind. Disabled by default.

parameters.name: MNT_DO_STAB
parameters.description:
Set to true for servo gimbal, false for passthrough.
This is required for a gimbal which is not capable of stabilizing itself
and relies on the IMU's attitude estimation.

parameters.name: MNT_FIXED_PITCH
parameters.display_name: Tracked pitch angle when in fixed mode (MNT_MODE_IN=5)
parameters.description: Tracked pitch angle when in fixed mode (MNT_MODE_IN=5)

parameters.name: MNT_LND_P_MAX
parameters.description: Pitch maximum when landed

parameters.name: MNT_LND_P_MIN
parameters.description: Pitch minimum when landed

parameters.name: MNT_MAN_PITCH
parameters.display_name: Auxiliary channel to control pitch (in AUX input or manual mode)
parameters.description: Auxiliary channel to control pitch (in AUX input or manual mode)

parameters.name: MNT_MAN_ROLL
parameters.display_name: Auxiliary channel to control roll (in AUX input or manual mode)
parameters.description: Auxiliary channel to control roll (in AUX input or manual mode)

parameters.name: MNT_MAN_YAW
parameters.display_name: Auxiliary channel to control yaw (in AUX input or manual mode)
parameters.description: Auxiliary channel to control yaw (in AUX input or manual mode)

parameters.name: MNT_MAV_COMPID
parameters.display_name: Mavlink Component ID of the mount
parameters.description: If MNT_MODE_OUT is MAVLink protocol v2, mount configure/control commands will be sent with this component ID.

parameters.name: MNT_MAV_SYSID
parameters.display_name: Mavlink System ID of the mount
parameters.description: If MNT_MODE_OUT is MAVLink gimbal protocol v1, mount configure/control commands will be sent with this target ID.

parameters.name: MNT_MAX_PITCH
parameters.display_name: Max positive angle of pitch setpoint (only in MNT_MODE_OUT=AUX)
parameters.description: Use output driver settings to calibrate (e.g. PWM_CENT/_MIN/_MAX).

parameters.name: MNT_MIN_PITCH
parameters.display_name: Min negative angle of pitch setpoint (only in MNT_MODE_OUT=AUX)
parameters.description: Use output driver settings to calibrate (e.g. PWM_CENT/_MIN/_MAX).

parameters.name: MNT_MODE_IN
parameters.description:
This is the protocol used between the ground station and the autopilot.

Recommended is Auto, RC only or MAVLink gimbal protocol v2.
The rest will be deprecated.

values.0: Auto (RC and MAVLink gimbal protocol v2)
values.5: Fixed world-frame attitude, not user controllable

parameters.name: MNT_MODE_OUT
parameters.description:
This is the protocol used between the autopilot and a connected gimbal.

Recommended is the MAVLink gimbal protocol v2 if the gimbal supports it.

In AUX mode, the gimbal (and hence the gimbal manager) is only made
available if at least one output channel is assigned a gimbal
roll/pitch/yaw output function (checked once at startup, so newly
assigned output functions require a reboot).

parameters.name: MNT_RANGE_ROLL
parameters.display_name: Range of roll channel output (only in MNT_MODE_OUT=AUX)
parameters.description: Use output driver settings to calibrate (e.g. PWM_CENT/_MIN/_MAX). Note that only symmetric angular ranges are supported.

parameters.name: MNT_RANGE_YAW
parameters.display_name: Range of yaw channel output (only in MNT_MODE_OUT=AUX)
parameters.description: Use output driver settings to calibrate (e.g. PWM_CENT/_MIN/_MAX). Note that only symmetric angular ranges are supported.

parameters.name: MNT_RATE_PITCH
parameters.display_name: Angular pitch rate for manual input in degrees/second
parameters.description: Full stick input [-1..1] translats to [-pitch rate..pitch rate].

parameters.name: MNT_RATE_YAW
parameters.display_name: Angular yaw rate for manual input in degrees/second
parameters.description: Full stick input [-1..1] translats to [-yaw rate..yaw rate].

parameters.name: MNT_RC_IN_MODE
parameters.display_name: Input mode for RC gimbal input
parameters.description: Input mode for RC gimbal input

parameters.name: MNT_TAU
parameters.display_name: Time constant for open-loop AUX gimbal control
parameters.description:
Alpha filter time constant defining the convergence rate (in seconds) for open-loop AUX mount control

Use when no angular position feedback is available.
With MNT_MODE_OUT set to AUX, the mount operates in open-loop and directly commands the servo output.
Parameters must be tuned for the specific servo to approximate its speed and response.

parameters.name: MOTFAIL_C2T
parameters.description:
Determines the slope between expected steady state current and linearized, normalized thrust command.
E.g. FD_ACT_MOT_C2T A represents the expected steady state current at 100%.
FD_ACT_LOW_OFF and FD_ACT_HIGH_OFF offset the threshold from that slope.

parameters.name: MOTFAIL_OFF
parameters.description: Check is triggered if `abs(FD_ACT_MOT_C2T * thrust - FD_ACT_OFF)` is above this value.

parameters.name: MOTFAIL_TIME
parameters.description: Motor failure only triggers after current thresholds are exceeded for this time.

parameters.name: MPC_ACC_DECOUPLE
parameters.description:
Set to decouple tilt from vertical acceleration.
This provides smoother flight but slightly worse tracking in position and auto modes.
Unset if accurate position tracking during dynamic maneuvers is more important than a smooth flight.

parameters.name: MPC_ACC_DOWN_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum downwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes
parameters.description: Maximum downwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes

parameters.name: MPC_ACC_HOR
parameters.display_name: Acceleration for autonomous and for manual modes
parameters.description: When piloting manually, this parameter is only used in MPC_POS_MODE Acceleration based.

parameters.name: MPC_ACC_HOR_MAX
parameters.description:
With MPC_POS_MODE=0 it limits deceleration.
With MPC_POS_MODE=4 it is unused (see MPC_ACC_HOR).

parameters.name: MPC_ACC_UP_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum upwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes
parameters.description: Maximum upwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes

parameters.name: MPC_ALT_MODE
parameters.description:
Control height
0: relative earth frame origin which may drift due to sensors
1: relative to ground (requires distance sensor) which changes with terrain variation.
It will revert to relative earth frame if the distance to ground estimate becomes invalid.
2: relative to ground (requires distance sensor) when stationary
and relative to earth frame when moving horizontally.
The speed threshold is MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY

parameters.name: MPC_AUTO_NUDGING
parameters.display_name: Enable stick nudging in autonomous modes
parameters.description:
Bitmask to enable pilot override of heading and position during auto modes.

Bit 0 - Yaw nudging: yaw stick rotates the heading in all auto types
(takeoff, mission, RTL, hold, landing). The new heading is held until a
mode switch resets it.

Bit 1 - Land nudging: during autonomous landing the pitch/roll sticks move
the vehicle horizontally, the throttle stick amends the descent speed
(stick full up: 0, centered: MPC_LAND_SPEED, full down: 2 * MPC_LAND_SPEED),
and the yaw stick rotates the heading.

Stick override must be disabled (set MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD = -1).

parameters.name: MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY
parameters.display_name: Max horizontal velocity for position hold
parameters.description:
Maximum horizontal velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check)

Only used with MPC_POS_MODE Direct velocity or MPC_ALT_MODE 2

parameters.name: MPC_HOLD_MAX_Z
parameters.display_name: Max vertical velocity for position hold
parameters.description:
Maximum vertical velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check)

Only used with MPC_ALT_MODE 1

parameters.name: MPC_JERK_AUTO
parameters.description:
Limit the maximum jerk of the vehicle (how fast the acceleration can change).
A lower value leads to smoother vehicle motions but also limited agility.

parameters.name: MPC_JERK_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum horizontal and vertical jerk in Position/Altitude mode
parameters.description:
Limit the maximum jerk (acceleration change) of the vehicle.
A lower value leads to smoother motions but limits agility.

Setting this to the maximum value essentially disables the limit.

Only used with MPC_POS_MODE Acceleration based.

parameters.name: MPC_LAND_ALT1
parameters.display_name: Altitude for 1. step of slow landing (descend)
parameters.description:
Below this altitude descending velocity gets limited to a value
between "MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN" (or "MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN") and "MPC_LAND_SPEED"
Value needs to be higher than "MPC_LAND_ALT2"

parameters.name: MPC_LAND_ALT2
parameters.display_name: Altitude for 2. step of slow landing (landing)
parameters.description:
Below this altitude descending velocity gets
limited to "MPC_LAND_SPEED"
Value needs to be lower than "MPC_LAND_ALT1"

parameters.name: MPC_LAND_ALT3
parameters.display_name: Altitude for 3. step of slow landing
parameters.description:
If a valid distance sensor measurement to the ground is available,
limit descending velocity to "MPC_LAND_CRWL" below this altitude.

parameters.name: MPC_LAND_CRWL
parameters.description: Used below MPC_LAND_ALT3 if distance sensor data is availabe.

parameters.name: MPC_LAND_RADIUS
parameters.description:
When landing nudging is enabled (MPC_AUTO_NUDGING bit 1), this defines the maximum
allowed horizontal displacement from the original landing point.
- If inside of the radius, only allow nudging inputs that do not move the vehicle outside of it.
- If outside of the radius, only allow nudging inputs that move the vehicle back towards it.

Set it to -1 for infinite radius.

parameters.name: MPC_LAND_SPEED
parameters.description: Landing descend rate

parameters.name: MPC_MANTHR_MIN
parameters.display_name: Minimum collective thrust in Stabilized mode
parameters.description:
The value is mapped to the lowest throttle stick position in Stabilized mode.

Too low collective thrust leads to loss of roll/pitch/yaw torque control authority.
Airmode is used to keep torque authority with zero thrust (see MC_AIRMODE).

parameters.name: MPC_MAN_TILT_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximal tilt angle in Stabilized, Altitude and Altitude Cruise mode
parameters.description: Maximal tilt angle in Stabilized, Altitude and Altitude Cruise mode

parameters.name: MPC_MAN_Y_MAX
parameters.display_name: Max manual yaw rate for Stabilized, Altitude, Position mode
parameters.description: Max manual yaw rate for Stabilized, Altitude, Position mode

parameters.name: MPC_MAN_Y_TAU
parameters.display_name: Manual yaw rate input filter time constant
parameters.description:
Not used in Stabilized mode
Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter

parameters.name: MPC_POS_MODE
parameters.description:
The supported sub-modes are:
Direct velocity:
Sticks directly map to velocity setpoints without smoothing.
Also applies to vertical direction and Altitude mode.
Useful for velocity control tuning.
Acceleration based:
Sticks map to acceleration and there's a virtual brake drag

parameters.name: MPC_THR_CURVE
parameters.display_name: Thrust curve mapping in Stabilized Mode
parameters.description:
Defines how the throttle stick is mapped to collective thrust in Stabilized mode.

Rescale to hover thrust estimate:
Stick input is linearly rescaled, such that a centered throttle stick corresponds to the hover thrust estimator's output.

No rescale:
Directly map the stick 1:1 to the output.
Can be useful with very low hover thrust which leads to much distortion and the upper half getting sensitive.

Rescale to hover thrust parameter:
Similar to rescaling to the hover thrust estimate, but it uses the hover thrust parameter value (see MPC_THR_HOVER) instead of estimated value.
With MPC_THR_HOVER 0.5 it's equivalent to No rescale.

parameters.name: MPC_THR_HOVER
parameters.description:
Mapped to center throttle stick in Stabilized mode (see MPC_THR_CURVE).
Used for initialization of the hover thrust estimator.
The estimated hover thrust is used as base for zero vertical acceleration in altitude control.
The hover thrust is important for land detection to work correctly.

parameters.name: MPC_THR_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum collective thrust in climb rate controlled modes
parameters.description: Limit allowed thrust e.g. for indoor test of overpowered vehicle.

parameters.name: MPC_THR_MIN
parameters.display_name: Minimum collective thrust in climb rate controlled modes
parameters.description:
Too low thrust leads to loss of roll/pitch/yaw torque control authority.
With airmode enabled this parameters can be set to 0
while still keeping torque authority (see MC_AIRMODE).

parameters.name: MPC_THR_XY_MARG
parameters.description:
Margin that is kept for horizontal control when higher priority vertical thrust is saturated.
To avoid completely starving horizontal control with high vertical error.

parameters.name: MPC_TILTMAX_AIR
parameters.description:
Absolute maximum for all velocity or acceleration controlled modes.
Any higher value is truncated.

parameters.name: MPC_TILTMAX_LND
parameters.display_name: Maximum tilt during initial takeoff ramp
parameters.description: Tighter tilt limit during takeoff to avoid tip over.

parameters.name: MPC_TKO_RAMP_T
parameters.description:
Increasing this value will make climb rate controlled takeoff slower.
If it's too slow the drone might scratch the ground and tip over.
A time constant of 0 disables the ramp

parameters.name: MPC_TKO_SPEED
parameters.description: Takeoff climb rate

parameters.name: MPC_VELD_LP
parameters.display_name: Velocity derivative low pass cutoff frequency
parameters.description: A value of 0 disables the filter.

parameters.name: MPC_VEL_LP
parameters.description: A value of 0 disables the filter.

parameters.name: MPC_VEL_MANUAL
parameters.display_name: Maximum horizontal velocity setpoint in Position mode
parameters.description:
Must be smaller than MPC_XY_VEL_MAX.

The maximum sideways and backward speed can be set differently
using MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE and MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK, respectively.

parameters.name: MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK
parameters.display_name: Maximum backward velocity in Position mode
parameters.description:
If set to a negative value or larger than
MPC_VEL_MANUAL then MPC_VEL_MANUAL is used.

parameters.name: MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE
parameters.display_name: Maximum sideways velocity in Position mode
parameters.description:
If set to a negative value or larger than
MPC_VEL_MANUAL then MPC_VEL_MANUAL is used.

parameters.name: MPC_VEL_NF_BW
parameters.description: A value of 0 disables the filter.

parameters.name: MPC_VEL_NF_FRQ
parameters.description:
The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the velocity.
A value of 0 disables the filter.

parameters.name: MPC_XY_CRUISE
parameters.display_name: Default horizontal velocity in autonomous modes
parameters.description: e.g. in Missions, RTL, Goto if the waypoint does not specify differently

parameters.name: MPC_XY_ERR_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum horizontal error allowed by the trajectory generator
parameters.description:
The integration speed of the trajectory setpoint is linearly
reduced with the horizontal position tracking error. When the
error is above this parameter, the integration of the
trajectory is stopped to wait for the drone.

This value can be adjusted depending on the tracking
capabilities of the vehicle. Set to 0 to disable the horizontal
time-stretch.

parameters.name: MPC_XY_P
parameters.display_name: Proportional gain for horizontal position error
parameters.description: Defined as corrective velocity in m/s per m position error

parameters.name: MPC_XY_TRAJ_P
parameters.display_name: Proportional gain for horizontal trajectory position error
parameters.description: Proportional gain for horizontal trajectory position error

parameters.name: MPC_XY_VEL_ALL
parameters.description:
If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
MPC_XY_VEL_MAX or MPC_VEL_MANUAL).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

parameters.name: MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC
parameters.display_name: Differential gain for horizontal velocity error
parameters.description: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative

parameters.name: MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC
parameters.display_name: Integral gain for horizontal velocity error
parameters.description:
Defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral
Allows to eliminate steady state errors in disturbances like wind.

parameters.name: MPC_XY_VEL_MAX
parameters.description:
Absolute maximum for all velocity controlled modes.
Any higher value is truncated.

parameters.name: MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC
parameters.display_name: Proportional gain for horizontal velocity error
parameters.description: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error

parameters.name: MPC_YAWRAUTO_ACC
parameters.display_name: Maximum yaw acceleration in autonomous modes
parameters.description:
Limits the acceleration of the yaw setpoint to avoid large
control output and mixer saturation.

parameters.name: MPC_YAWRAUTO_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum yaw rate in autonomous modes
parameters.description:
Limits the rate of change of the yaw setpoint to avoid large
control output and mixer saturation.

parameters.name: MPC_YAW_MODE
parameters.description: Heading behavior in autonomous modes

parameters.name: MPC_Z_ERR_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum vertical error allowed by the trajectory generator
parameters.description:
Vertical analog of MPC_XY_ERR_MAX. When the smoothed trajectory z
leads the drone by more than this value, trajectory integration is
slowed down so the virtual setpoint can't walk away from the drone.
This suppresses altitude overshoots caused by a noisy altitude
reference (e.g. mission setpoint jittering as the home altitude
estimate is refined in flight). Set to 0 to disable the vertical
time-stretch.

parameters.name: MPC_Z_P
parameters.display_name: Proportional gain for vertical position error
parameters.description: Defined as corrective velocity in m/s per m position error

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_ALL
parameters.description:
If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP or MPC_LAND_SPEED).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC
parameters.display_name: Differential gain for vertical velocity error
parameters.description: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC
parameters.display_name: Integral gain for vertical velocity error
parameters.description: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN
parameters.description:
Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes.
In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity.

For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP
parameters.description:
Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes.
In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity.

For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC
parameters.display_name: Proportional gain for vertical velocity error
parameters.description: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error

parameters.name: MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN
parameters.description: For manual modes and offboard, see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN

parameters.name: MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP
parameters.description: For manually controlled modes and offboard see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP

parameters.name: NAV_ACC_RAD
parameters.description:
Default acceptance radius, overridden by acceptance radius of waypoint if set.
For fixed-wing and rovers, the high level controllers output their own acceptance radius. Those values are used instead only when above this parameter.

parameters.name: NAV_DLL_ACT
parameters.display_name: Set GCS connection loss failsafe mode
parameters.description:
The GCS connection loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_DL_LOSS_T in seconds. Once the timeout occurs the selected
action will be executed.

parameters.name: NAV_FORCE_VT
parameters.display_name: Force VTOL mode takeoff and land
parameters.description: Force VTOL mode takeoff and land

parameters.name: NAV_FW_ALTL_RAD
parameters.display_name: FW Altitude Acceptance Radius before a landing
parameters.description:
Altitude acceptance used for the last waypoint before a fixed-wing landing. This is usually smaller
than the standard vertical acceptance because close to the ground higher accuracy is required.

parameters.name: NAV_FW_ALT_RAD
parameters.description: Acceptance radius for fixedwing altitude.

parameters.name: NAV_LOITER_RAD
parameters.description:
Default value of loiter radius in fixed-wing mode (e.g. for Loiter mode).

The direction of the loiter can be set via the sign: A positive value for
clockwise, negative for counter-clockwise.

parameters.name: NAV_LTR_LAST_DL
parameters.display_name: Loiter at last GCS heartbeat position on data link loss
parameters.description:
When the data link is lost and this setting is enabled,
the vehicle will loiter at the position where the last GCS
heartbeat was received rather than at its current position.
Only applies to Hold mode during failsafe actions.

parameters.name: NAV_MC_ALT_RAD
parameters.description: Acceptance radius for multicopter altitude.

parameters.name: NAV_MIN_GND_DIST
parameters.display_name: Minimum height above ground during Mission and RTL
parameters.description:
Minimum height above ground the vehicle is allowed to descend to during Mission and RTL,
excluding landing commands.
Requires a distance sensor to be set up.
Note: only prevents the vehicle from descending further, but does not force it to climb.

Set to a negative value to disable.

parameters.name: NAV_MIN_LTR_ALT
parameters.description:
This is the minimum altitude above Home the system will always obey in Loiter (Hold) mode if switched into this
mode without specifying an altitude (e.g. through Loiter switch on RC).
Doesn't affect Loiters that are part of Missions or that are entered through a reposition setpoint ("Go to").
Set to a negative value to disable.

parameters.name: NAV_RCL_ACT
parameters.display_name: Set manual control loss failsafe mode
parameters.description:
The manual control loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_RC_LOSS_T in seconds.

"Hold mode (no failsafe)" does not trigger the failsafe: instead, if manual control
is lost while actively flying a manual mode, the vehicle switches to Hold as a regular
mode change (no failsafe state, no alarming notification). If Hold cannot be entered
(e.g. without a valid position estimate), the normal failsafe takes over and escalates
from there (Return/Land/Descend/Terminate as applicable).

parameters.name: NAV_TRAFF_AVOID
parameters.description:
Action requested for a crosstrack traffic conflict.
Runtime changes apply on later conflict level transitions.

parameters.name: NAV_TRAFF_A_HOR
parameters.description: Maximum absolute distance from the projected traffic track.

parameters.name: NAV_TRAFF_A_VER
parameters.description: Crosstrack vertical separation threshold

parameters.name: NAV_TRAFF_COLL_T
parameters.description:
A conflict is raised when the time estimate is below this threshold.
The estimate is the current 3D separation divided by the sum of the ownship and traffic speed magnitudes.

parameters.name: NPFG_DAMPING
parameters.description: Damping ratio of NPFG control law.

parameters.name: NPFG_LB_PERIOD
parameters.display_name: Enable automatic lower bound on the NPFG period
parameters.description:
Avoids limit cycling from a too aggressively tuned period/damping combination.
If false, also disables upper bound NPFG_PERIOD_UB.

parameters.name: NPFG_PERIOD
parameters.description: Period of NPFG control law.

parameters.name: NPFG_PERIOD_SF
parameters.description:
Multiplied by period for conservative minimum period bounding (when period lower
bounding is enabled). 1.0 bounds at marginal stability.

parameters.name: NPFG_ROLL_TC
parameters.description:
Time constant of roll controller command / response, modeled as first order delay.
Used to determine lower period bound. Setting zero disables automatic period bounding.

parameters.name: NPFG_SW_DST_MLT
parameters.description:
Multiplied by the track error boundary to determine when the aircraft switches
to the next waypoint and/or path segment. Should be less than 1.

parameters.name: NPFG_UB_PERIOD
parameters.display_name: Enable automatic upper bound on the NPFG period
parameters.description: Adapts period to maintain track keeping in variable winds and path curvature.

parameters.name: OSD_CH_HEIGHT
parameters.description:
Controls the vertical position of the crosshair display.
Resolution is limited by OSD to 15 discrete values. Negative
values will display the crosshairs below the horizon

parameters.name: OSD_DWELL_TIME
parameters.description: Amount of time in milliseconds to dwell at the beginning of the display, when scrolling.

parameters.name: OSD_LOG_LEVEL
parameters.description: Minimum security of log level to display on the OSD.

parameters.name: OSD_RC_STICK
parameters.description: Forward RC stick input to VTX when disarmed

parameters.name: OSD_SCROLL_RATE
parameters.description:
Scroll rate in milliseconds for OSD messages longer than available character width.
This is lower-bounded by the nominal loop rate of this module.

parameters.name: OSD_SYMBOLS
parameters.description: Configure / toggle support display options.

parameters.name: PD_GRIPPER_TO
parameters.display_name: Timeout for successful gripper actuation acknowledgement
parameters.description:
Maximum time Gripper will wait while the successful griper actuation isn't recognised.
If the gripper has no feedback sensor, it will simply wait for
this time before considering gripper actuation successful and publish a
'VehicleCommandAck' signaling successful gripper action

parameters.name: PD_GRIPPER_TYPE
parameters.description: Selects the types of control actions the gripper accepts.

parameters.name: PLD_BTOUT
parameters.description: Time after which the landing target is considered lost without any new measurements.

parameters.name: PLD_FAPPR_ALT
parameters.description: Allow final approach (without horizontal positioning) if losing landing target closer than this to the ground.

parameters.name: PLD_HACC_RAD
parameters.description: Start descending if closer above landing target than this.

parameters.name: PLD_MAX_SRCH
parameters.description: Maximum number of times to search for the landing target if it is lost during the precision landing.

parameters.name: PLD_MOVING_T_MAX
parameters.description:
When the landing target is moving, precision land aims at the estimated future
target position after a constrained prediction time. This sets the maximum time.

parameters.name: PLD_MOVING_T_MIN
parameters.description:
When the landing target is moving, precision land aims at the estimated future
target position after a constrained prediction time. This sets the minimum time.

parameters.name: PLD_SRCH_ALT
parameters.description: Altitude above home to which to climb when searching for the landing target.

parameters.name: PLD_SRCH_TOUT
parameters.description: Time allowed to search for the landing target before falling back to normal landing.

parameters.name: PLD_YAW_EN
parameters.display_name: Set to true to control yaw while landing
parameters.description: Control the orientation when landing. The orientation comes from the topic vte_orientation.

parameters.name: PP_LOOKAHD_GAIN
parameters.display_name: Tuning parameter for the pure pursuit controller
parameters.description: Lower value -> More aggressive controller (beware overshoot/oscillations)

parameters.name: PP_LOOKAHD_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum lookahead distance for the pure pursuit controller
parameters.description: Maximum lookahead distance for the pure pursuit controller

parameters.name: PP_LOOKAHD_MIN
parameters.display_name: Minimum lookahead distance for the pure pursuit controller
parameters.description: Minimum lookahead distance for the pure pursuit controller

parameters.name: RA_ACC_RAD_GAIN
parameters.description:
The geometric ideal acceptance radius is multiplied by this factor
to account for kinematic and dynamic effects.
Higher value -> The rover starts to cut the corner earlier.

parameters.name: RA_ACC_RAD_MAX

parameters.description:

the previous, current and next waypoint.
Higher value -> smoother trajectory at the cost of how close the rover gets
to the waypoint (Set to -1 to disable corner cutting).

parameters.description:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

parameters.name: RC_CHAN_CNT
parameters.description:
Number of channels detected during RC calibration. Must be non-zero
for RC manual control input to be accepted.

parameters.name: RC_ENG_MOT_TH
parameters.display_name: Threshold for selecting main motor engage
parameters.description:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

parameters.name: RC_FAILS_THR
parameters.description:
Use RC_MAP_FAILSAFE to specify which channel is used to indicate RC loss via this threshold.
By default this is the throttle channel.

Set to a PWM value slightly above the PWM value for the channel (e.g. throttle) in a failsafe event,
but below the minimum PWM value for the channel during normal operation.

Note: The default value of 0 disables the feature (it is below the expected range).

parameters.name: RC_GEAR_TH

parameters.description:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

parameters.description:
Use it to arm/disarm via switch instead of default throttle stick. If this is
assigned, arming and disarming via stick is disabled.

parameters.description: AUX1 Passthrough RC channel

parameters.name: RC_MAP_AUX2
parameters.description: AUX2 Passthrough RC channel

parameters.description: AUX3 Passthrough RC channel

parameters.display_name: RC channel to engage the main motor (for helicopters)
parameters.description: RC channel to engage the main motor (for helicopters)

parameters.name: RC_MAP_FAILSAFE
parameters.description:
Configures which RC channel is used by the receiver to indicate the signal was lost
(on receivers that use output a fixed signal value to report lost signal).
If set to 0, the channel mapped to throttle is used.

Use RC_FAILS_THR to set the threshold indicating lost signal. By default it's below
the expected range and hence disabled.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_FLAPS
parameters.description: Flaps channel

parameters.name: RC_MAP_FLTMODE
parameters.description:
If this parameter is non-zero, flight modes are only selected
by this channel and are assigned to six slots.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_FLTM_BTN
parameters.description:
This bitmask allows to specify multiple channels for changing flight modes using
momentary buttons. Each channel is assigned to a mode slot ((lowest channel = slot 1).
The resulting modes for each slot X is defined by the COM_FLTMODEX parameters.
The functionality can be used only if RC_MAP_FLTMODE is disabled.

The maximum number of available slots and hence bits set in the mask is 6.

bitmask.0: Mask Channel 1 as a mode button
bitmask.1: Mask Channel 2 as a mode button
bitmask.2: Mask Channel 3 as a mode button
bitmask.3: Mask Channel 4 as a mode button
bitmask.4: Mask Channel 5 as a mode button
bitmask.5: Mask Channel 6 as a mode button
bitmask.6: Mask Channel 7 as a mode button
bitmask.7: Mask Channel 8 as a mode button
bitmask.8: Mask Channel 9 as a mode button
bitmask.9: Mask Channel 10 as a mode button
bitmask.10: Mask Channel 11 as a mode button
bitmask.11: Mask Channel 12 as a mode button
bitmask.12: Mask Channel 13 as a mode button
bitmask.13: Mask Channel 14 as a mode button
bitmask.14: Mask Channel 15 as a mode button
bitmask.15: Mask Channel 16 as a mode button
bitmask.16: Mask Channel 17 as a mode button
bitmask.17: Mask Channel 18 as a mode button

parameters.name: RC_MAP_GEAR_SW
parameters.description: Landing gear switch channel

parameters.name: RC_MAP_KILL_SW
parameters.description:
This channel immediately sets all outputs to their disarmed values, parachutes are NOT deployed.
Unlike termination this can be undone. Quickly flipping the switch back restores control.
System auto-disarms after 5 seconds, preflight checks and re-arming are then required.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_LOITER_SW
parameters.description: Loiter switch channel

parameters.name: RC_MAP_MODE_SW
parameters.description:
This is the main flight mode selector.
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for deciding about the main mode.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_OFFB_SW
parameters.description: Offboard switch channel

parameters.name: RC_MAP_PARAM1
parameters.description:
Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 1st parameter channel.
Set to 0 to deactivate *

parameters.name: RC_MAP_PARAM2
parameters.description:
Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 2nd parameter channel.
Set to 0 to deactivate *

parameters.name: RC_MAP_PARAM3
parameters.description:
Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 3th parameter channel.
Set to 0 to deactivate *

parameters.name: RC_MAP_PAY_SW
parameters.description: Payload Power Switch RC channel

parameters.name: RC_MAP_PITCH
parameters.description:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading pitch inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_RETURN_SW
parameters.description: Return switch channel

parameters.name: RC_MAP_ROLL
parameters.description:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading roll inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_TERM_SW
parameters.description:
This channel triggers irreversible flight termination:
All outputs are disabled and set to their failsafe values (disarmed by default)
and MAVLink parachutes are triggered.

Unlike a kill switch, this cannot be undone until system reboot. Use with caution.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_THROTTLE
parameters.description:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading throttle inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_TRANS_SW
parameters.description: VTOL transition switch channel mapping

parameters.name: RC_MAP_YAW
parameters.description:

which channel should be used for reading yaw inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th

parameters.name: RC_PAYLOAD_MIDTH

0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison

0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min

0: do not read RSSI from input channel
1-18: read RSSI from specified input channel

parameters.name: RD_TRANS_DRV_TRN
parameters.display_name: Yaw error threshold to switch from driving to spot turning
parameters.description:
This threshold is used for the state machine to switch from driving to turning based on the
error between the desired and actual yaw. It is also used as the threshold whether the rover should come
to a smooth stop at the next waypoint. This slow down effect is active if the angle between the
line segments from prevWP-currWP and currWP-nextWP is smaller then 180 - RD_TRANS_DRV_TRN.

parameters.name: RD_TRANS_TRN_DRV
parameters.display_name: Yaw error threshold to switch from spot turning to driving
parameters.description:
This threshold is used for the state machine to switch from turning to driving based on the
error between the desired and actual yaw.

parameters.name: RD_WHEEL_TRACK
parameters.description: Distance from the center of the right wheel to the center of the left wheel.

parameters.name: RD_YAW_STK_GAIN
parameters.display_name: Yaw stick gain for Manual mode
parameters.description: Assign value <1.0 to decrease stick response for yaw control.

parameters.name: RM_COURSE_CTL_TH
parameters.display_name: Threshold to update course control in manual position mode
parameters.description:
Threshold for the angle between the active cruise direction and the cruise direction given
by the stick inputs.
This can be understood as a deadzone for the combined stick inputs for forward/backwards
and lateral speed which defines a course direction.

parameters.name: RM_WHEEL_TRACK
parameters.description: Distance from the center of the right wheel to the center of the left wheel.

parameters.name: RM_YAW_STK_GAIN
parameters.display_name: Yaw stick gain for Manual mode
parameters.description: Assign value <1.0 to decrease stick response for yaw control.

parameters.name: RO_ACCEL_LIM
parameters.description:
Set to -1 to disable.
For mecanum rovers this limit is used for longitudinal and lateral acceleration.

parameters.name: RO_DECEL_LIM
parameters.description:
Set to -1 to disable.
Note that if it is disabled the rover will not slow down when approaching waypoints in auto modes.
For mecanum rovers this limit is used for longitudinal and lateral deceleration.

parameters.name: RO_JERK_LIM
parameters.description:
Set to -1 to disable.
Note that if it is disabled the rover will not slow down when approaching waypoints in auto modes.
For mecanum rovers this limit is used for longitudinal and lateral jerk.

parameters.name: RO_MAX_THR_SPEED
parameters.display_name: Speed the rover drives at maximum throttle
parameters.description: Used to linearly map speeds [m/s] to throttle values [-1. 1].

parameters.name: RO_SPEED_I
parameters.display_name: Integral gain for ground speed controller
parameters.description: Integral gain for ground speed controller

parameters.name: RO_SPEED_LIM
parameters.description: Used to cap speed setpoints and map controller inputs to speed setpoints in Position mode.

parameters.name: RO_SPEED_P
parameters.display_name: Proportional gain for ground speed controller
parameters.description: Proportional gain for ground speed controller

parameters.name: RO_SPEED_RED
parameters.display_name: Tuning parameter for the speed reduction based on the course error
parameters.description:
```
Reduced_speed = RO_MAX_THR_SPEED * (1 - normalized_course_error * RO_SPEED_RED)
```
The normalized course error is the angle between the current course and the bearing setpoint
interpolated from [0, 180] -> [0, 1].
Higher value -> More speed reduction.
Note: This is also used to calculate the speed at which the vehicle arrives at a waypoint in auto modes.
Set to -1 to disable bearing error based speed reduction.

parameters.name: RO_SPEED_TH
parameters.description:
Set to -1 to disable.
The minimum threshold for the speed measurement not to be interpreted as zero.

parameters.name: RO_YAW_ACCEL_LIM
parameters.description:
Used to cap how quickly the magnitude of yaw rate setpoints can increase.
Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: RO_YAW_DECEL_LIM
parameters.description:
Used to cap how quickly the magnitude of yaw rate setpoints can decrease.
Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: RO_YAW_EXPO
parameters.description:
Exponential factor for tuning the input curve shape.

0 Purely linear input curve
1 Purely cubic input curve

parameters.name: RO_YAW_P
parameters.display_name: Proportional gain for closed loop yaw controller
parameters.description: Proportional gain for closed loop yaw controller

parameters.name: RO_YAW_RATE_CORR
parameters.description:
Multiplicative correction factor for the feedforward mapping of the yaw rate controller.
Increase this value (x > 1) if the measured yaw rate is lower than the setpoint, decrease (0 < x < 1) otherwise.
Note: Tuning this is particularly useful for skid-steered rovers, or rovers with misaligned wheels/steering axes
that cause a lot of friction when turning.

parameters.name: RO_YAW_RATE_I
parameters.display_name: Integral gain for closed loop yaw rate controller
parameters.description: Integral gain for closed loop yaw rate controller

parameters.name: RO_YAW_RATE_LIM
parameters.description:
Used to cap yaw rate setpoints and map controller inputs to yaw rate setpoints
in Acro, Stabilized and Position mode.

parameters.name: RO_YAW_RATE_P
parameters.display_name: Proportional gain for closed loop yaw rate controller
parameters.description: Proportional gain for closed loop yaw rate controller

parameters.name: RO_YAW_RATE_TH
parameters.description: The minimum threshold for the yaw rate measurement not to be interpreted as zero.

parameters.name: RO_YAW_STICK_DZ
parameters.description: Percentage of stick input range that will be interpreted as zero around the stick centered value.

parameters.name: RO_YAW_SUPEXPO
parameters.description:
"Superexponential" factor for refining the input curve shape tuned using RO_YAW_EXPO.

0 Pure Expo function
0.7 reasonable shape enhancement for intuitive stick feel
0.95 very strong bent input curve only near maxima have effect

parameters.name: RTL_APPR_FORCE
parameters.description:
Only consider home/rally RTL points that have a VTOL approach loiter.
A VTOL approach loiter is a MAV_CMD_NAV_LOITER_TO_ALT item with finite position and altitude.

parameters.name: RTL_CONE_ANG
parameters.display_name: Half-angle of the return mode altitude cone
parameters.description:
Defines the half-angle of a cone centered around the destination position that
affects the altitude at which the vehicle returns.

values.0: No cone, always climb to RTL_RETURN_ALT above destination.
values.90: Only climb to at least RTL_DESCEND_ALT above destination.

parameters.name: RTL_DESCEND_ALT
parameters.description:
Descend to this altitude (above destination position) after return, and wait for time defined in RTL_LAND_DELAY.
Land (i.e. slowly descend) from this altitude if autolanding allowed.
VTOLs do transition to hover in this altitude above the landing point.

parameters.name: RTL_LAND_DELAY
parameters.description:
Delay before landing (after initial descent) in Return mode.
If set to -1 the system will not land but loiter at RTL_DESCEND_ALT.

parameters.name: RTL_LOITER_RAD
parameters.description: Set the radius for loitering to a safe altitude for VTOL transition.

parameters.name: RTL_MIN_DIST
parameters.display_name: Min distance for RTL cone altitude calculation
parameters.description:
Horizontal radius from return point within which special rules for return mode apply

The return altitude will be calculated based on RTL_CONE_ANG parameter.
The yaw setpoint will switch to the one defined by corresponding waypoint.

parameters.name: RTL_PLD_MD
parameters.description:
Use precision landing when doing an RTL landing phase.
This setting does not apply for RTL destinations planned as part of a mission.

parameters.name: RTL_RETURN_ALT
parameters.description:
Default minimum altitude above destination (e.g. home, safe point, landing pattern) for return flight.
The vehicle will climb to this altitude when Return mode is engaged, unless it currently is flying higher already.
This is affected by RTL_MIN_DIST and RTL_CONE_ANG.

parameters.name: RTL_TIME_FACTOR
parameters.display_name: RTL time estimate safety margin factor
parameters.description:
Safety factor that is used to scale the actual RTL time estimate.
Time with margin = RTL_TIME_FACTOR * time + RTL_TIME_MARGIN

parameters.name: RTL_TIME_MARGIN
parameters.display_name: RTL time estimate safety margin offset
parameters.description:
Margin that is added to the time estimate, after it has already been scaled
Time with margin = RTL_TIME_FACTOR * time + RTL_TIME_MARGIN

parameters.name: RTL_TYPE
parameters.description: Return mode destination and flight path (home location, rally point, mission landing pattern, reverse mission)

values.0: Return to closest safe point (home or rally point) via direct path.
values.1: Return to closest safe point other than home (mission landing pattern or rally point), via direct path. If no mission landing or rally points are defined return home via direct path. Always choose closest safe landing point if vehicle is a VTOL in hover mode.
values.2: Return to a planned mission landing, if available, using the mission path while skipping DO_JUMP and other non-position mission items, else return to home via the reverse mission path with the same traversal rules. Do not consider rally points.
values.3: Return via direct path to closest destination: home, start of mission landing pattern or safe point. If the destination is a mission landing pattern, follow the pattern to land.
values.4: Return to the planned mission landing, or to home via the reverse mission path, whichever is estimated to be closer using mission item indices. Skip DO_JUMP and other non-position mission items while following either mission path. Do not consider rally points.
values.5: Return directly to safe landing point (do not consider mission landing and Home)

parameters.name: RWTO_MAX_THR
parameters.description: Throttle during runway takeoff

parameters.name: RWTO_NUDGE
parameters.display_name: Enable yaw stick nudging during runway ground roll
parameters.description:
Enable use of yaw stick for nudging the wheel during runway ground roll

This is useful when map, GNSS, or yaw errors on ground are misaligned with what the operator intends for takeoff course.
Particularly useful for skinny runways or if the wheel servo is a bit off trim.

parameters.name: RWTO_PSP
parameters.display_name: Pitch setpoint during taxi / before rotation
parameters.description:
Pitch setpoint during taxi / before takeoff rotation airspeed is reached

A taildragger with steerable wheel might need to pitch up
a little to keep its wheel on the ground before airspeed
to takeoff is reached.

parameters.name: RWTO_RAMP_TIME
parameters.display_name: Throttle ramp up time for runway takeoff
parameters.description: Throttle ramp up time for runway takeoff

parameters.name: RWTO_ROT_AIRSPD
parameters.description:
The calibrated airspeed threshold during the takeoff ground roll when the plane should start rotating (pitching up).
Must be less than the takeoff airspeed, will otherwise be capped at the takeoff airspeed (see FW_TKO_AIRSPD).

If set <= 0.0, defaults to 0.9 * takeoff airspeed (see FW_TKO_AIRSPD)

parameters.name: RWTO_ROT_TIME
parameters.description: This is the time desired to linearly ramp in takeoff pitch constraints during the takeoff rotation

parameters.name: RWTO_TKOFF
parameters.description: Runway takeoff with landing gear

parameters.name: SDLOG_BACKEND
parameters.description: If no logging is set the logger will not be started. Set bits true to enable: 0: SD card logging 1: Mavlink logging

parameters.name: SDLOG_BOOT_BAT
parameters.description: When enabled, logging will not start from boot if battery power is not detected (e.g. powered via USB on a test bench). This prevents extraneous flight logs from being created during bench testing. Note that this only applies to log-from-boot modes. This has no effect on arm-based modes.

parameters.name: SDLOG_DIRS_MAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum number of log directories to keep
parameters.description: If greater than 0, the oldest log directories are deleted at log start to keep the total directory count at or below this value. This cleanup is orthogonal to the free-space cleanup driven by SDLOG_ROTATE and SDLOG_MAX_SIZE, and is useful for capping log usage by count independent of available disk size (e.g. in SITL). A value of 0 disables this count-based cleanup.

parameters.name: SDLOG_MAX_SIZE
parameters.description: Maximum size of a single log file in mebibytes (1 MiB = 1024 * 1024 bytes). When reached, the log file is closed and a new one is started. This value is also added to the cleanup threshold (see SDLOG_ROTATE) to reserve headroom for the next log file. A value of 0 disables both file rotation and the cleanup reservation. Must stay below the FAT32 file size limit of 4 GiB.

parameters.name: SDLOG_MISSION
parameters.description: If enabled, a small additional "mission" log file will be written to the SD card. The log contains just those messages that are useful for tasks like generating flight statistics and geotagging. The different modes can be used to further reduce the logged data (and thus the log file size). For example, choose geotagging mode to only log data required for geotagging. Note that the normal/full log is still created, and contains all the data in the mission log (and more).

parameters.name: SDLOG_MODE
parameters.description: Determines when to start and stop logging. By default, logging is started when arming the system, and stopped when disarming. Note: The logging start/end points that can be configured here only apply to SD logging. The mavlink backend is started/stopped independently of these points.

parameters.name: SDLOG_PROFILE
parameters.description: This integer bitmask controls the set and rates of logged topics. The default allows for general log analysis while keeping the log file size reasonably small. Enabling multiple sets leads to higher bandwidth requirements and larger log files. Set bits true to enable: 0 : Default set (used for general log analysis) 1 : Full rate estimator (EKF2) replay topics 2 : Topics for thermal calibration (high rate raw IMU and Baro sensor data) 3 : Topics for system identification (high rate actuator control and IMU data) 4 : Full rates for analysis of fast maneuvers (RC, attitude, rates and actuators) 5 : Debugging topics (debug_*.msg topics, for custom code) 6 : Topics for sensor comparison (low rate raw IMU, Baro and magnetometer data) 7 : Topics for computer vision and collision prevention 8 : Raw FIFO high-rate IMU (Gyro) 9 : Raw FIFO high-rate IMU (Accel) 10: Logging of mavlink tunnel message (useful for payload communication debugging)

parameters.name: SDLOG_ROTATE
parameters.description: Maximum percentage of disk space that logs may occupy during operation, including while writing a new log file. For example, a value of 90 means at least 10% of disk is always kept free, even while writing. A value of 100 lets logs fill the disk completely. A value of 0 disables space-based cleanup entirely. At log start, oldest logs are deleted as needed to maintain this guarantee, accounting for the next file write of up to SDLOG_MAX_SIZE. Cleanup always happens at log start (not boot) so logs can be downloaded via FTP before deletion.

parameters.name: SDLOG_UTC_OFFSET
parameters.description: the difference in hours and minutes from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) for a your place and date. for example, In case of South Korea(UTC+09:00), UTC offset is 540 min (9*60) refer to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_UTC_time_offsets

parameters.name: SDLOG_UUID
parameters.description: If set to 1, add an ID to the log, which uniquely identifies the vehicle

parameters.name: SENS_BARO_QNH
parameters.description: QNH for barometer

parameters.name: SENS_BARO_RATE
parameters.description:
Barometric air data maximum publication rate. This is an upper bound,
actual barometric data rate is still dependent on the sensor.

parameters.name: SENS_BAR_AUTOCAL
parameters.description: Automatically calibrate barometer based on the GNSS height

parameters.name: SENS_BOARD_ROT
parameters.description: This parameter defines the rotation of the FMU board relative to the platform.

parameters.name: SENS_BOARD_X_OFF
parameters.description:
Rotation from flight controller board to vehicle body frame.
This parameter gets set during the "level horizon" calibration or can be
set manually.

parameters.name: SENS_BOARD_Y_OFF
parameters.description:
Rotation from flight controller board to vehicle body frame.
This parameter gets set during the "level horizon" calibration or can be
set manually.

parameters.name: SENS_BOARD_Z_OFF
parameters.description:
Rotation from flight controller board to vehicle body frame.
Has to be set manually (not set by any calibration).

parameters.name: SENS_DPRES_ANSC
parameters.description:
Pick the appropriate scaling from the datasheet.
this number defines the (linear) conversion from voltage
to Pascal (pa). For the MPXV7002DP this is 1000.

NOTE: If the sensor always registers zero, try switching
the static and dynamic tubes.

parameters.name: SENS_DPRES_OFF
parameters.description: The offset (zero-reading) in Pascal

parameters.name: SENS_DPRES_REV
parameters.description:
Reverse the raw measurements of all differential pressure sensors.
This can be enabled if the sensors have static and dynamic ports swapped.

parameters.name: SENS_EN_AGPSIM
parameters.description: Simulate Aux Global Position (AGP)

parameters.name: SENS_EN_ARSPDSIM
parameters.description: Enable simulated airspeed sensor instance

parameters.name: SENS_EN_BAROSIM
parameters.description: Enable simulated barometer sensor instance

parameters.name: SENS_EN_GPSSIM
parameters.description: Enable simulated GPS instance

parameters.name: SENS_EN_MAGSIM
parameters.description: Enable simulated magnetometer sensor instance

parameters.name: SENS_EN_THERMAL
parameters.description: Thermal control of sensor temperature

parameters.name: SENS_EXT_I2C_PRB
parameters.description: Probe for optional external I2C devices.

parameters.name: SENS_FLOW_MAXHGT
parameters.display_name: Maximum height above ground when reliant on optical flow
parameters.description:
This parameter defines the maximum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably.
The height setpoint will be limited to be no greater than this value when the navigation system
is completely reliant on optical flow data and the height above ground estimate is valid.
The sensor may be usable above this height, but accuracy will progressively degrade.

parameters.name: SENS_FLOW_MAXR
parameters.display_name: Max angular flow rate measurable by sensor
parameters.description:
Magnitude of maximum angular flow rate reliably measurable by the optical flow sensor

Optical flow data will not fused by the estimators if the magnitude of the flow rate exceeds this value and
control loops will be instructed to limit ground speed such that the flow rate produced by movement over ground
is less than 50% of this value.

parameters.name: SENS_FLOW_MINHGT
parameters.display_name: Minimum height above ground when reliant on optical flow
parameters.description:
This parameter defines the minimum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably.
The sensor may be usable below this height, but accuracy will progressively reduce to loss of focus.

parameters.name: SENS_FLOW_RATE
parameters.description:
Optical flow data maximum publication rate. This is an upper bound,
actual optical flow data rate is still dependent on the sensor.

parameters.name: SENS_FLOW_ROT
parameters.description:
This parameter defines the yaw rotation of the optical flow relative to the vehicle body frame.
Zero rotation is defined as X on flow board pointing towards front of vehicle.

parameters.name: SENS_FLOW_SCALE
parameters.description: Optical flow scale factor

parameters.name: SENS_GPS0_DELAY
parameters.description:
GPS measurement delay relative to IMU measurements.
Matched to physical GPS receiver via SENS_GPS0_ID.
Only applied when the GPS driver does not provide its own
timestamp_sample correction.

parameters.name: SENS_GPS0_ID
parameters.description:
Device ID of the GPS receiver for antenna offset slot 0.
Set to 0 to disable this slot. When all slots are 0, offsets are
matched by uORB instance index (only reliable for serial GPS).

parameters.name: SENS_GPS0_OFFX
parameters.description:
Forward axis relative to vehicle centre of gravity.
Matched to physical GPS receiver via SENS_GPS0_ID.

parameters.name: SENS_GPS0_OFFY
parameters.description:
Right axis relative to vehicle centre of gravity.
Matched to physical GPS receiver via SENS_GPS0_ID.

parameters.name: SENS_GPS0_OFFZ
parameters.description:
Down axis relative to vehicle centre of gravity.
Matched to physical GPS receiver via SENS_GPS0_ID.

parameters.name: SENS_GPS1_DELAY
parameters.description:
GPS measurement delay relative to IMU measurements.
Matched to physical GPS receiver via SENS_GPS1_ID.
Only applied when the GPS driver does not provide its own
timestamp_sample correction.

parameters.name: SENS_GPS1_ID
parameters.description:
Device ID of the GPS receiver for antenna offset slot 1.
Set to 0 to disable this slot. When all slots are 0, offsets are
matched by uORB instance index (only reliable for serial GPS).

parameters.name: SENS_GPS1_OFFX
parameters.description:
Forward axis relative to vehicle centre of gravity.
Matched to physical GPS receiver via SENS_GPS1_ID.

parameters.name: SENS_GPS1_OFFY
parameters.description:
Right axis relative to vehicle centre of gravity.
Matched to physical GPS receiver via SENS_GPS1_ID.

parameters.name: SENS_GPS1_OFFZ
parameters.description:
Down axis relative to vehicle centre of gravity.
Matched to physical GPS receiver via SENS_GPS1_ID.

parameters.name: SENS_GPS_MASK
parameters.description:
Set bits in the following positions to set which GPS accuracy metrics will
be used to calculate the blending weight. Set to zero to disable and always
used first GPS instance.

parameters.name: SENS_GPS_PRIME
parameters.description:
When no blending is active, this defines the preferred GPS receiver instance.
The GPS selection logic waits until the primary receiver is available to
send data to the EKF even if a secondary instance is already available.
The secondary instance is then only used if the primary one times out.

To select a DroneCAN GPS, set this to the node ID.

The primary receiver is reported in the GPS_RAW_INT MAVLink
message and the secondary in GPS2_RAW.

This parameter has no effect on the EKF GPS selection if
blending is active.

parameters.name: SENS_GPS_TAU
parameters.description:
Sets the longest time constant that will be applied to the calculation of GPS
position and height offsets used to correct data from multiple GPS data for
steady state position differences.

parameters.name: SENS_IMU_AUTOCAL
parameters.description: Automatically initialize IMU (accel/gyro) calibration from bias estimates if available.

parameters.name: SENS_IMU_CLPNOTI
parameters.description: Notify the user if the IMU is clipping

parameters.name: SENS_IMU_MODE
parameters.description: Sensors hub IMU mode

parameters.name: SENS_INT_BARO_EN
parameters.description: For systems with an external barometer, this should be set to false to make sure that the external is used.

parameters.name: SENS_MAG_AUTOCAL
parameters.description: Automatically initialize magnetometer calibration from bias estimate if available. The estimate only captures hard-iron offsets, so a full calibration is still recommended. Mainly intended for remote nodes (e.g. CAN GPS units) that cannot be calibrated from a ground station.

parameters.name: SENS_MAG_AUTOROT
parameters.description: During calibration attempt to automatically determine the rotation of external magnetometers.

parameters.name: SENS_MAG_MODE
parameters.description: Sensors hub mag mode

parameters.name: SENS_MAG_RATE
parameters.description:
Magnetometer data maximum publication rate. This is an upper bound,
actual magnetometer data rate is still dependent on the sensor.

parameters.name: SENS_MAG_SIDES
parameters.display_name: Bitfield selecting mag sides for calibration
parameters.description:
If set to two side calibration, only the offsets are estimated, the scale
calibration is left unchanged. Thus an initial six side calibration is
recommended.

Bits:
ORIENTATION_TAIL_DOWN = 1
ORIENTATION_NOSE_DOWN = 2
ORIENTATION_LEFT = 4
ORIENTATION_RIGHT = 8
ORIENTATION_UPSIDE_DOWN = 16
ORIENTATION_RIGHTSIDE_UP = 32

parameters.name: SEP_AUTO_CONFIG
parameters.description:
By default, the receiver is automatically configured. Sometimes it may be used for multiple purposes.
If the offered parameters aren't sufficient, this parameter can be disabled to have full control of the receiver configuration.
A good way to use this is to enable automatic configuration, let the receiver be configured, and then disable it to make manual adjustments.

parameters.name: SEP_CONST_USAGE
parameters.description:
Choice of which constellations the receiver should use for PVT computation.

When this is 0, the constellation usage isn't changed.

parameters.name: SEP_DUMP_COMM
parameters.description:
Log raw communication between the driver and connected receivers.
For example, "To receiver" will log all commands and corrections sent by the driver to the receiver.

parameters.name: SEP_HARDW_SETUP
parameters.display_name: Setup and expected use of the hardware
parameters.description:
Setup and expected use of the hardware.

- Default: Use two receivers as completely separate instances.
- Moving base: Use two receivers in a rover & moving base setup for heading.

parameters.name: SEP_LOG_FORCE
parameters.display_name: Whether to overwrite or add to existing logging
parameters.description: When the receiver is already set up to log data, this decides whether extra logged data should be added or overwrite existing data.

parameters.name: SEP_LOG_HZ
parameters.description: Select the frequency at which the connected receiver should log data to its internal storage.

parameters.name: SEP_LOG_LEVEL
parameters.description: Select the level of detail that needs to be logged by the receiver.

parameters.name: SEP_OUTP_HZ
parameters.display_name: Output frequency of main SBF blocks
parameters.description: The output frequency of the main SBF blocks needed for PVT information.

parameters.name: SEP_PITCH_OFFS
parameters.display_name: Pitch offset for dual antenna GPS
parameters.description:
Vertical offsets can be compensated for by adjusting the Pitch offset.

Note that this can be interpreted as the "roll" angle in case the antennas are aligned along the perpendicular axis.
This occurs in situations where the two antenna ARPs may not be exactly at the same height in the vehicle reference frame.
Since pitch is defined as the right-handed rotation about the vehicle Y axis,
a situation where the main antenna is mounted lower than the aux antenna (assuming the default antenna setup) will result in a positive pitch.

parameters.name: SEP_SAT_INFO
parameters.description: Enable publication of satellite info (ORB_ID(satellite_info)) if possible.

parameters.name: SEP_STREAM_LOG
parameters.display_name: Logging stream used during automatic configuration
parameters.description:
The stream the autopilot sets up on the receiver to output the logging data.

Set this to another value if the default stream is already used for another purpose.

parameters.name: SEP_STREAM_MAIN
parameters.display_name: Main stream used during automatic configuration
parameters.description:
The stream the autopilot sets up on the receiver to output the main data.

Set this to another value if the default stream is already used for another purpose.

parameters.name: SEP_YAW_OFFS
parameters.display_name: Heading/Yaw offset for dual antenna GPS
parameters.description:
Heading offset angle for dual antenna GPS setups that support heading estimation.

Set this to 0 if the antennas are parallel to the forward-facing direction
of the vehicle and the rover antenna is in front.

The offset angle increases clockwise.

Set this to 90 if the rover antenna is placed on the
right side of the vehicle and the moving base antenna is on the left side.

parameters.name: SIH_DISTSNSR_MAX
parameters.description: distance sensor maximum range

parameters.description: CP(J) = CP0 + CP1*J + CP2*J^2

parameters.name: SIH_F_CT0
parameters.description: Forward thruster static thrust coefficient

parameters.name: SIH_F_CT1
parameters.description: CT(J) = CT0 + CT1*J + CT2*J^2

parameters.name: SIH_F_CT2
parameters.description: CT(J) = CT0 + CT1*J + CT2*J^2
