parameters.description: Forward thruster propeller diameter in inches

parameters.name: SIH_F_Q_MAX
parameters.description:
This is used for the Fixed-Wing, Tailsitter, or pusher of the Standard VTOL
if SIH_F_CP0 <= 0.
If SIH_F_CP0 > 0, propeller model with advance ratio J is used
and this parameter value is overridden at simulation startup.

parameters.name: SIH_F_RPM_MAX
parameters.description: Forward thruster max RPM

parameters.name: SIH_F_T_MAX
parameters.description:
This is used for the Fixed-Wing, Tailsitter, or pusher of the Standard VTOL
if SIH_F_CT0 <= 0.
If SIH_F_CT0 > 0, propeller model with advance ratio J is used
and this parameter value is overridden at simulation startup.

parameters.name: SIH_IXX
parameters.description:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

parameters.name: SIH_IXY
parameters.description:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

parameters.name: SIH_IXZ
parameters.description:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

parameters.name: SIH_IYY
parameters.description:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

parameters.name: SIH_IYZ
parameters.description:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

parameters.name: SIH_IZZ
parameters.description:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

parameters.name: SIH_KDV
parameters.description:
Physical coefficient representing the friction with air particles.
The greater this value, the slower the quad will move.

Drag force function of velocity: D=-KDV*V.
The maximum freefall velocity can be computed as V=10*MASS/KDV [m/s]

parameters.name: SIH_KDW
parameters.description:
Physical coefficient representing the friction with air particles during rotations.
The greater this value, the slower the quad will rotate.

Aerodynamic moment function of body rate: Ma=-KDW*W_B.
This value can be set to 0 if unknown.

parameters.name: SIH_LOC_H0
parameters.description:
This value represents the Above Mean Sea Level (AMSL) altitude where the simulation begins.

If using FlightGear as a visual animation,
this value can be tweaked such that the vehicle lies on the ground at takeoff.

LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others
to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

parameters.name: SIH_LOC_LAT0
parameters.description:
This value represents the North-South location on Earth where the simulation begins.

LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others
to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

parameters.name: SIH_LOC_LON0
parameters.description:
This value represents the East-West location on Earth where the simulation begins.

LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others
to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

parameters.name: SIH_LOC_YAW0
parameters.display_name: Initial heading (yaw) of the simulated vehicle
parameters.description: This value represents the initial heading (yaw) of the simulated vehicle at the start of the simulation.

parameters.name: SIH_L_PITCH
parameters.description:
This is the arm length generating the pitching moment

This value can be measured with a ruler.
This corresponds to half the distance between the front and rear motors.

parameters.name: SIH_L_ROLL
parameters.description:
This is the arm length generating the rolling moment

This value can be measured with a ruler.
This corresponds to half the distance between the left and right motors.

parameters.name: SIH_MASS
parameters.description: This value can be measured by weighting the quad on a scale.

parameters.name: SIH_Q_MAX
parameters.description:
This is the maximum torque delivered by one propeller
when the motor is running at full speed.

This value is usually about few percent of the maximum thrust force.

Refer to SIH_F_Q_MAX for the propeller torque for FW, Tailsitter, and VTOL pusher.

parameters.name: SIH_RNGBC_NOISE
parameters.display_name: Ranging beacon measurement noise standard deviation
parameters.description: Gaussian noise added to simulated ranging beacon measurements. Set to 0 to disable noise.

parameters.name: SIH_T_MAX
parameters.description:
This is the maximum force delivered by one propeller
when the motor is running at full speed.

This value is usually about 5 times the mass of the quadrotor.

Refer to SIH_F_T_MAX for the thrust for FW, Tailsitter, and VTOL pusher.

parameters.name: SIH_T_TAU
parameters.description: the time taken for the thruster to step from 0 to 100% should be about 4 times tau

parameters.name: SIH_VEHICLE_TYPE
parameters.description: Vehicle type

parameters.name: SIH_WIND_E
parameters.description: Wind velocity from east direction

parameters.name: SIH_WIND_N
parameters.description: Wind velocity from north direction

parameters.name: SIM_AGP_FAIL
parameters.description:
Stuck: freeze the measurement to the current location
Drift: add a linearly growing bias to the sensor data

parameters.name: SIM_BARO_OFF_P
parameters.description: simulated barometer pressure offset

parameters.name: SIM_BARO_OFF_T
parameters.description: simulated barometer temperature offset

parameters.name: SIM_BAT_DRAIN
parameters.description: Time in seconds for the simulated battery to drain from 100% to 0% while armed. Set to 0 to disable the battery simulator entirely (useful when battery state is provided externally, e.g. via MAVLink).

parameters.name: SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT
parameters.description:
Can be used to alter the battery level during SITL- or HITL-simulation on the fly.
Particularly useful for testing different low-battery behaviour.

parameters.name: SIM_GPS_USED
parameters.display_name: simulated GPS number of satellites used
parameters.description: simulated GPS number of satellites used

parameters.name: SIM_MAG_OFFSET_X
parameters.description: simulated magnetometer X offset

parameters.name: SIM_MAG_OFFSET_Y
parameters.description: simulated magnetometer Y offset

parameters.name: SIM_MAG_OFFSET_Z
parameters.description: simulated magnetometer Z offset

parameters.name: SYS_AUTOCFG_CAL
parameters.description:
If enabled, a SYS_AUTOCONFIG reset overwrites stored sensor calibration with the airframe's built-in defaults.
Enable when the airframe ships its own calibration.

parameters.name: SYS_AUTOCONFIG
parameters.description:
Set to 1 to reset parameters on next system startup (setting defaults).
Platform-specific values are used if available.
RC* parameters are preserved.

parameters.name: SYS_AUTOSTART
parameters.description: CHANGING THIS VALUE REQUIRES A RESTART. Defines the auto-start script used to bootstrap the system.

parameters.name: SYS_BL_UPDATE
parameters.description:
If enabled, update the bootloader on the next boot.

WARNING: do not cut the power during an update process, otherwise you will
have to recover using some alternative method (e.g. JTAG).

Instructions:
- Insert an SD card
- Enable this parameter
- Reboot the board (plug the power or send a reboot command)
- Wait until the board comes back up (or at least 2 minutes)
- If it does not come back, check the file bootlog.txt on the SD card

parameters.name: SYS_CAL_ACCEL
parameters.display_name: Auto start accel thermal calibration on next boot
parameters.description:
Enable auto start of accelerometer thermal calibration at the next power up

0 : Set to 0 to do nothing
1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot
This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts.

default (0, no calibration)

parameters.name: SYS_CAL_BARO
parameters.display_name: Auto start baro thermal calibration on next boot
parameters.description:
Enable auto start of barometer thermal calibration at the next power up

0 : Set to 0 to do nothing
1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot
This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts.

default (0, no calibration)

parameters.name: SYS_CAL_GYRO
parameters.display_name: Auto start gyro thermal calibration on next boot
parameters.description:
Enable auto start of rate gyro thermal calibration at the next power up

0 : Set to 0 to do nothing
1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot
This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts.

default (0, no calibration)

parameters.name: SYS_CAL_TDEL
parameters.display_name: Required temperature rise during thermal calibration
parameters.description:
A temperature increase greater than this value is required during calibration.
Calibration will complete for each sensor when the temperature increase above the starting temperature exceeds the value set by SYS_CAL_TDEL.
If the temperature rise is insufficient, the calibration will continue indefinitely and the board will need to be repowered to exit.

parameters.name: SYS_CAL_TMAX
parameters.display_name: Maximum starting temperature for thermal calibration
parameters.description: Temperature calibration will not start if the temperature of any sensor is higher than the value set by SYS_CAL_TMAX.

parameters.name: SYS_CAL_TMIN
parameters.display_name: Minimum starting temperature for thermal calibration
parameters.description: Temperature calibration for each sensor will ignore data if the temperature is lower than the value set by SYS_CAL_TMIN.

parameters.name: SYS_DM_BACKEND
parameters.description:
If the board supports persistent storage (i.e., the KConfig variable DATAMAN_PERSISTENT_STORAGE is set),
the 'Default storage' backend uses a file on persistent storage. If not supported, this backend uses
non-persistent storage in RAM.

parameters.name: SYS_FAC_CAL_MODE
parameters.description:
If enabled, future sensor calibrations will be stored to /fs/mtd_caldata.

Note: this is only supported on boards with a separate calibration storage
/fs/mtd_caldata.

parameters.name: SYS_FAILURE_EN
parameters.description:
If enabled allows Injection of Failures.

WARNING: the failures can easily cause crashes and are to be used with caution!

parameters.name: SYS_FAIL_RC_INST
parameters.display_name: Instance failed by the RC switch
parameters.description:
Which instance of SYS_FAIL_RC_UNIT the SYS_FAIL_RC_SRC trigger affects.
1-based, or 0 for all instances (motor number for motors).

parameters.name: SYS_FAIL_RC_MODE
parameters.display_name: Failure type applied by the RC switch
parameters.description:
How SYS_FAIL_RC_UNIT fails when the SYS_FAIL_RC_SRC trigger fires, on SYS_FAIL_RC_INST.
unsupported (unit, type) pairs are ignored.

parameters.name: SYS_FAIL_RC_SRC
parameters.display_name: RC aux input that triggers failure injection

parameters.name: SYS_FAIL_RC_UNIT
parameters.display_name: Component failed by the RC switch
parameters.description:
Which component the SYS_FAIL_RC_SRC trigger fails, with SYS_FAIL_RC_MODE on
SYS_FAIL_RC_INST.

parameters.name: SYS_HAS_BARO
parameters.display_name: Control if the vehicle has a barometer
parameters.description:
Disable this if the board has no barometer, such as some of the Omnibus
F4 SD variants.
If disabled, the preflight checks will not check for the presence of a
barometer.

parameters.name: SYS_HAS_GPS
parameters.display_name: Control if the vehicle has a GPS
parameters.description:
Disable this if the system has no GPS.
If disabled, the sensors hub will not process sensor_gps,
and GPS will not be available for the rest of the system.

parameters.name: SYS_HAS_MAG
parameters.display_name: Control if and how many magnetometers are expected
parameters.description:
0: System has no magnetometer, preflight checks should pass without one.
1-N: Require the presence of N magnetometer sensors for check to pass.

parameters.name: SYS_HAS_NUM_ASPD
parameters.display_name: Control if the vehicle has an airspeed sensor
parameters.description:
Set this to 0 if the board has no airspeed sensor.
If set to 0, the preflight checks will not check for the presence of an
airspeed sensor.

parameters.name: SYS_HAS_NUM_DIST
parameters.display_name: Number of distance sensors to check being available
parameters.description:
The preflight check will fail if fewer than this number of distance sensors with valid data is present.

Disable the check with 0.

parameters.name: SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS
parameters.display_name: Control if and how many GNSS receivers are required
parameters.description:
0: No minimum receiver count required. Position divergence between two receivers
and loss of a GNSS receiver still produce a warning but never trigger the
COM_GNSSLOSS_ACT failsafe action.
1-N: Require the presence of N GNSS receivers for arming and during flight.
If the active count drops below this value in flight, COM_GNSSLOSS_ACT is triggered.
When set to 2, position divergence between the two receivers also triggers COM_GNSSLOSS_ACT.

parameters.name: SYS_HAS_NUM_OF
parameters.display_name: Number of optical flow sensors required to be available
parameters.description: The preflight check will fail if fewer than this number of optical flow sensors with valid data are present.

parameters.name: SYS_HITL
parameters.display_name: Enable HITL/SIH mode on next boot
parameters.description:
While enabled the system will boot in Hardware-In-The-Loop (HITL)
or Simulation-In-Hardware (SIH) mode and not enable all sensors and checks.
When disabled the same vehicle can be flown normally.

Set to 'external HITL', if the system should perform as if it were a real
vehicle (the only difference to a real system is then only the parameter
value, which can be used for log analysis).

parameters.name: SYS_PARAM_VER
parameters.description:
This is used internally only: an airframe configuration might set an expected
parameter version value via PARAM_DEFAULTS_VER. This is checked on bootup
against SYS_PARAM_VER, and if they do not match, parameters are reset and
reloaded from the airframe configuration.

parameters.name: SYS_RGB_MAXBRT
parameters.description: Set to 0 to disable, 1 for maximum brightness

parameters.name: SYS_STCK_EN
parameters.description: Enable stack checking

parameters.name: SYS_TIME_SRC
parameters.display_name: Select the source of the system time
parameters.description:
This parameter selects the source allowed to set the system time.
The default value enables all sources.

parameters.name: SYS_VEHICLE_RESP
parameters.description:
Changes the overall responsiveness of the vehicle.
The higher the value, the faster the vehicle will react.

If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
the acceleration or jerk limits).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

parameters.name: THR_MDL_FAC
parameters.display_name: Thrust to motor control signal model parameter
parameters.description:
Parameter used to model the nonlinear relationship between
motor control signal (e.g. PWM) and static thrust.

The model is:

```
rel_thrust = factor * rel_signal^2 + (1-factor) * rel_signal
```
, where rel_thrust is the normalized thrust between 0 and 1, and
rel_signal is the relative motor control signal between 0 and 1.

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_AG_IP
parameters.description:
If ethernet is enabled and is the selected configuration for uXRCE-DDS,
the selected Agent IP address will be set and used.
Decimal dot notation is not supported. IP address must be provided
in int32 format. For example, 192.168.1.2 is mapped to -1062731518;
127.0.0.1 is mapped to 2130706433.

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_DOM_ID
parameters.description: uXRCE-DDS domain ID

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_FLCTRL
parameters.display_name: Enable serial flow control for UXRCE interface
parameters.description:
This is used to enable flow control for the serial uXRCE instance.
Used for reliable high bandwidth communication.

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_KEY
parameters.description:
uXRCE-DDS key, must be different from zero.
In a single agent - multi client configuration, each client
must have a unique session key.

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_NS_IDX
parameters.description:
Defines an index-based namespace for DDS messages, e.g, uav_0, uav_1, up to uav_9999
A value less than zero leaves the namespace empty

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_PRT
parameters.description:
If ethernet is enabled and is the selected configuration for uXRCE-DDS,
the selected UDP port will be set and used.

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_PTCFG
parameters.description:
Set the participant configuration on the Agent's system.
0: Use the default configuration.
1: Restrict messages to localhost
(use in combination with ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1).
2: Use a custom participant with the profile name "px4_participant".

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_RX_TO
parameters.description:
Specifies after how many seconds without receiving data the DDS connection is reestablished.
A value less than one disables the RX rate timeout.

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_SYNCC
parameters.description: When enabled along with UXRCE_DDS_SYNCT, uxrce_dds_client will set the system clock using the agents UTC timestamp.

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_SYNCT
parameters.description: When enabled, uxrce_dds_client will synchronize the timestamps of the incoming and outgoing messages measuring the offset between the Agent OS time and the PX4 time.

parameters.name: UXRCE_DDS_TX_TO
parameters.description:
Specifies after how many seconds without sending data the DDS connection is reestablished.
A value less than one disables the TX rate timeout.

parameters.name: VTE_ACC_D_UNC
parameters.display_name: UAV acceleration white-noise power spectral density
parameters.description:
White-noise PSD on the UAV acceleration input. The
1-sigma vel_uav change allowed over a time t is sqrt(VTE_ACC_D_UNC * t).

This is a variance rate, not a per-step variance; the value is independent
of the filter update rate. Higher values let the filter follow new
measurements more tightly and reject fewer outliers.

Unit: m^2/s^3.

parameters.name: VTE_ACC_T_UNC
parameters.description:
Process-noise spectral density of the target acceleration random walk
(moving-target builds only). The 1-sigma target-acceleration change over a
time t is sqrt(VTE_ACC_T_UNC * t) (e.g. for the 0.1 default, ~0.32 m/s^2
after 1 s, ~1.0 m/s^2 after 10 s).

This is a variance rate, not a linear rate of change; the value is
independent of the filter update rate. Higher values let the filter follow
target manoeuvres more aggressively and accept more outliers.

Unit: ((m/s^2)^2)/s.

parameters.name: VTE_ACC_UNC_IN
parameters.description:
Initial variance of the relative target acceleration in x, y, and z directions
(moving-target builds only).
Changes while the estimator is running are picked up immediately by the module but only take effect
the next time the estimator initializes or resets.
Once the filter is running, the steady-state target-acceleration variance is
governed by VTE_ACC_T_UNC and the measurement updates, so this parameter does
not influence runtime behaviour.

parameters.name: VTE_AID_MASK
parameters.display_name: Integer bitmask controlling data fusion and aiding methods
parameters.description:
Set bits in the following positions to enable:
0 : Set to true to use the target's GNSS position data if available. (+1)
1 : Set to true to use the UAV GNSS velocity data if available. (+2)
2 : Set to true to use the target relative position from vision-based data if available. (+4)
3 : Set to true to use the mission land point. Ignored if target GNSS position enabled. (+8)
4 : Set to true to use the target GNSS velocity if available. (+16)

parameters.name: VTE_BIAS_UNC
parameters.description:
Process-noise spectral density of the GPS/vision bias random walk. The
1-sigma expected bias change over a time t is sqrt(VTE_BIAS_UNC * t) (e.g.
for the 0.001 default, ~3 cm after 1 s, ~10 cm after 10 s, ~32 cm after
100 s).

This is a variance rate, not a linear drift rate; the value is independent
of the filter update rate. Higher values let the bias follow new
observations more aggressively; lower values keep it stiff. Tune to match
the realistic physical drift of the absolute reference (typically a few
centimetres over tens of seconds for consumer GNSS, less for RTK).

Unit: m^2/s.

parameters.name: VTE_BIA_AVG_THR
parameters.description:
When the GNSS/vision bias first becomes observable while the estimator is still referenced to GNSS,
VTE low-pass filters the first GNSS/vision bias samples before activating the bias estimate.
The LPF exit requires consecutive raw bias samples to stay within this threshold and for the LPF
to have run for at least 2 * tau, or until VTE_BIA_AVG_TOUT elapses.

parameters.name: VTE_BIA_AVG_TOUT
parameters.description:
Maximum time spent averaging the initial GNSS bias before activating it once GNSS and vision
are jointly observable while the estimator is still referenced to GNSS. During that phase, valid
vision samples keep updating the LPF. While the current GNSS-relative measurement stays valid,
it can be propagated with the UAV velocity estimate to match the vision timestamp. If that GNSS
sample is no longer valid, averaging stops, the current vision position is used, and the current
LPF bias is activated.

Set to 0 to disable averaging and activate the bias immediately.

parameters.name: VTE_BIA_UNC_IN
parameters.description:
Initial variance of the bias between the GPS on the target and the GPS on the drone.
Changes while the estimator is running are picked up immediately by the module but only take effect
the next time the estimator initializes or resets.
Once the filter is running, the steady-state bias variance is governed by VTE_BIAS_UNC
and the measurement updates, so this parameter does not influence runtime behaviour.
Keep it large so initialization can absorb initial misalignments.

parameters.name: VTE_BTOUT
parameters.description: Time after which the target is considered lost without any new fused measurements. When this timeout expires, the estimator is reset and can restart immediately once an enabled fusion source is available.

parameters.name: VTE_EN
parameters.description: Vision Target Estimator module enable

parameters.name: VTE_EVA_NOISE
parameters.display_name: Minimum standard deviation for vision yaw observations
parameters.description:
Lower bound on the standard deviation used when fusing the vision yaw
observation. The estimator squares this value and clamps the per-sample
observation variance to max(reported_variance, VTE_EVA_NOISE^2). The floor only
takes effect when the sensor under-reports its own noise.
The default of ~0.07 rad (4 deg) is a reasonable starting point for marker-based
yaw detection. Lowering it makes the filter trust each yaw sample more, which
can cause the controller to chase the resulting setpoint changes and oscillate.

parameters.name: VTE_EVP_NOISE
parameters.display_name: Minimum standard deviation for vision relative-position observations
parameters.description:
Lower bound on the standard deviation used when fusing the vision relative
position. The estimator squares this value and clamps the per-sample
observation variance to max(reported_variance, VTE_EVP_NOISE^2). The floor only
takes effect when the sensor under-reports its own noise.

parameters.name: VTE_GPS_P_NOISE
parameters.display_name: Minimum standard deviation for GPS position observations
parameters.description:
Lower bound on the standard deviation used when fusing GPS position (target or
mission landing waypoint). The estimator squares this value and clamps the
per-sample observation variance to max(reported_variance, VTE_GPS_P_NOISE^2).
The floor only takes effect when the sensor under-reports its own noise.

parameters.name: VTE_GPS_V_NOISE
parameters.display_name: Minimum standard deviation for GPS velocity observations
parameters.description:
Lower bound on the standard deviation used when fusing GPS velocity. The
estimator squares this value and clamps the per-sample observation variance
to max(reported_variance, VTE_GPS_V_NOISE^2). The floor only takes effect when
the sensor under-reports its own noise; if the reported variance is already
above the floor, this parameter has no effect.

parameters.name: VTE_M_REC_TOUT
parameters.description: Time window for considering a raw measurement as recent and eligible for fusion.

parameters.name: VTE_M_UPD_TOUT
parameters.description: Maximum allowed age of a retained measurement before it is discarded from the estimator's cache.

parameters.name: VTE_POS_EN
parameters.display_name: Vision Target Estimator module enable position estimation
parameters.description: Vision Target Estimator module enable position estimation

parameters.name: VTE_POS_NIS_THRE
parameters.display_name: Normalized innovation squared threshold for the position estimator
parameters.description:
Lower values mean that more measurements will be rejected. Null hypothesis H0: the innovation is
consistent with the innovation covariance matrix. Values of 0.46, 1.64, 2.71, 3.84, 6.63, and 10.83
correspond to 50%, 20%, 10%, 5%, 1%, and 0.1% probability respectively that H0 is incorrectly rejected.
The confidence interval is computed from the chi-squared distribution.

parameters.name: VTE_POS_UNC_IN
parameters.display_name: Initial target and drone relative position uncertainty
parameters.description:
Initial variance of the relative target position in x, y, and z direction.
Changes while the estimator is running are picked up immediately by the module but only take effect
the next time the estimator initializes or resets.

parameters.name: VTE_TASK_MASK
parameters.display_name: Integer bitmask controlling the tasks of the target estimator
parameters.description:
Set bits in the following positions to enable:
0 : Set to true to use the vision target estimator for precision landing. (+1)
1 : DEBUG, always active. (+2)

parameters.name: VTE_TGT_TOUT
parameters.description: Maximum time without any fused measurements before the published relative pose/yaw is flagged invalid.

parameters.name: VTE_VEL_UNC_IN
parameters.display_name: Initial target and drone relative velocity uncertainty
parameters.description:
Initial variance of the relative target velocity in x, y, and z directions.
Changes while the estimator is running are picked up immediately by the module but only take effect
the next time the estimator initializes or resets.

parameters.name: VTE_YAW_ACC_UNC
parameters.display_name: Yaw acceleration white-noise power spectral density
parameters.description:
White-noise PSD on the yaw acceleration driving the
yaw-rate state. The 1-sigma yaw-rate change allowed over a time t is
sqrt(VTE_YAW_ACC_UNC * t) (e.g. for the 0.004 default, ~3.6 deg/s after 1 s,
~11.5 deg/s after 10 s).

This is a variance rate, not a per-step variance; the value is independent
of the filter update rate. Higher values let the filter follow rapid
heading changes; lower values smooth the yaw estimate aggressively.

Unit: rad^2/s^3.

parameters.name: VTE_YAW_EN
parameters.display_name: Vision Target Estimator module enable orientation estimation
parameters.description: Vision Target Estimator module enable orientation estimation

parameters.name: VTE_YAW_NIS_THRE
parameters.display_name: Normalized innovation squared threshold for the orientation estimator
parameters.description:
Lower values mean that more measurements will be rejected. Null hypothesis H0: the innovation is
consistent with the innovation covariance matrix. Values of 0.46, 1.64, 2.71, 3.84, 6.63, and 10.83
correspond to 50%, 20%, 10%, 5%, 1%, and 0.1% probability respectively that H0 is incorrectly rejected.
The confidence interval is computed from the chi-squared distribution.

parameters.name: VTE_YAW_UNC_IN
parameters.description:
Initial variance of the target orientation yaw in rad^2.
Changes while the estimator is running are picked up immediately by the module but only take effect
the next time the estimator initializes or resets.

parameters.name: VT_B_DEC_I
parameters.display_name: Backtransition deceleration setpoint to tilt I gain
parameters.description: Backtransition deceleration setpoint to tilt I gain

parameters.name: VT_B_DEC_MSS
parameters.description:
Used to calculate back transition distance in an auto mode.
For standard vtol and tiltrotors a controller is used to track this value during the transition.

parameters.name: VT_B_TRANS_DUR
parameters.display_name: Maximum duration of a back transition
parameters.description: Transition is also declared over if the groundspeed drops below MPC_XY_CRUISE.

parameters.name: VT_B_TRANS_RAMP
parameters.display_name: Back transition MC motor ramp up time
parameters.description: This sets the duration during which the MC motors ramp up to the commanded thrust during the back transition stage.

parameters.name: VT_ELEV_MC_LOCK
parameters.description: If set to 1 the control surfaces are locked at the disarmed value in multicopter mode.

parameters.name: VT_FWD_THRUST_EN
parameters.display_name: Use fixed-wing actuation in hover to accelerate forward
parameters.description:
Prevents downforce from pitching the body down when facing wind.
Uses puller/pusher (standard VTOL), or forward-tilt (tiltrotor VTOL) to accelerate forward instead.
Only active if demanded pitch  is below VT_PITCH_MIN.
Use VT_FWD_THRUST_SC to tune it.
Descend mode is treated as Landing too.

Only active (if enabled) in height-rate controlled modes.

parameters.name: VT_FWD_THRUST_SC
parameters.display_name: Fixed-wing actuation thrust scale in hover
parameters.description:
Scale applied to the demanded pitch (below VT_PITCH_MIN) to get the fixed-wing forward actuation in hover mode.
Enabled via VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.

parameters.name: VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN
parameters.description:
Enable differential thrust separately for roll, pitch, yaw in forward (fixed-wing) mode.
The effectiveness of differential thrust around the corresponding axis can be
tuned by setting VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R / VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P / VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y.

parameters.name: VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P
parameters.display_name: Pitch differential thrust factor in forward flight
parameters.description: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

parameters.name: VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R
parameters.display_name: Roll differential thrust factor in forward flight
parameters.description: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

parameters.name: VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y
parameters.display_name: Yaw differential thrust factor in forward flight
parameters.description: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

parameters.name: VT_FW_MIN_ALT
parameters.description:
Minimum altitude for fixed-wing flight. When the vehicle is in fixed-wing mode
and the altitude drops below this altitude (relative altitude above local origin),
it will instantly switch back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.

parameters.name: VT_FW_QC_HMAX
parameters.description:
Maximum height above the ground (if available, otherwise above
Home if available, otherwise above the local origin) where triggering a quad-chute is possible.
At high altitudes there is a big risk to deplete the battery and therefore crash if quad-chuting there.

parameters.name: VT_FW_QC_P
parameters.description:
Absolute pitch threshold for quad-chute triggering in FW mode.
Above this the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.
Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

parameters.name: VT_FW_QC_R
parameters.description:
Absolute roll threshold for quad-chute triggering in FW mode.
Above this the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.
Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

parameters.name: VT_F_TRANS_DUR
parameters.description: Time in seconds used for a transition

parameters.name: VT_F_TRANS_THR
parameters.display_name: Target throttle value for the transition to fixed-wing flight
parameters.description: Scaled by the square root of the weight ratio (WEIGHT_GROSS / WEIGHT_BASE).

parameters.name: VT_F_TR_OL_TM
parameters.description:
The duration of the front transition when there is no airspeed feedback available.
When airspeed is used, transition timeout is declared if airspeed does not
reach VT_ARSP_BLEND after this time.

parameters.name: VT_LND_PITCH_MIN
parameters.display_name: Minimum pitch angle during hover landing
parameters.description:
Overrides VT_PITCH_MIN when the vehicle is in LAND mode (hovering).
During landing it can be beneficial to reduce the pitch angle to reduce the generated lift in head wind.

parameters.name: VT_PITCH_MIN
parameters.description:
Any pitch setpoint below this value is translated to a forward force by the fixed-wing forward actuation if
VT_FWD_TRHUST_EN is set.

parameters.name: VT_PSHER_SLEW
parameters.display_name: Pusher throttle ramp up slew rate
parameters.description:
Defines the slew rate of the puller/pusher throttle during transitions.
Zero will deactivate the slew rate limiting and thus produce an instant throttle
rise to the transition throttle VT_F_TRANS_THR.

parameters.name: VT_QC_ALT_LOSS
parameters.description:
Altitude error threshold for quad-chute triggering during fixed-wing flight.
The check is only active if altitude is controlled and the vehicle is below the current altitude reference.
The altitude error is relative to the highest altitude the vehicle has achieved since it has flown below the current
altitude reference.

Set to 0 do disable.

parameters.name: VT_QC_T_ALT_LOSS
parameters.description:
Altitude loss threshold for quad-chute triggering during VTOL transition to fixed-wing flight
in altitude-controlled flight modes.
Active until 5s after completing transition to fixed-wing.
If the current altitude is more than this value below the altitude at the beginning of the
transition, it will instantly switch back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.

Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

parameters.name: VT_SPOILER_MC_LD
parameters.description: Spoiler setting while landing (hover)

parameters.name: VT_TILT_TRANS
parameters.display_name: Normalized tilt in transition to FW
parameters.description: Normalized tilt in transition to FW

parameters.name: VT_TRANS_MIN_TM
parameters.description: Minimum time in seconds for front transition.

parameters.name: VT_TRANS_P2_DUR
parameters.description: Time in seconds it takes to tilt form VT_TILT_TRANS to VT_TILT_FW.

parameters.name: VT_TRANS_TIMEOUT

parameters.name: VT_TYPE
parameters.description: VTOL Type (Tailsitter=0, Tiltrotor=1, Standard=2)

parameters.name: WEIGHT_BASE
parameters.description:
This is the weight of the vehicle at which it's performance limits were derived. A zero or negative value
disables trim throttle and minimum airspeed compensation based on weight.

parameters.name: WEIGHT_GROSS
parameters.description:
This is the actual weight of the vehicle at any time. This value will differ from WEIGHT_BASE in case weight was added
or removed from the base weight. Examples are the addition of payloads or larger batteries. A zero or negative value
disables trim throttle and minimum airspeed compensation based on weight.
